definition_zh: 回报率；收益率
definition_en: the gain from an investment expressed as a percentage of its cost
core_image: 一只天平，一端放投入，另一端放回收，两个数字相除得出一个百分比
scene: 项目评审会上，分析师把预计收益与投入成本相除，得到一个按年计算的百分比。 Analysts calculated the rate of return before approving the project.
sceneCN: 这里指「回报率」，对应第 1 个义项：收益相对于投入的百分比；句意为分析师在批准项目之前先计算了回报率。画面要点：评审桌、计算器、成本与收益两栏。

pos.zh: 回报率；收益率（常与投资、项目或资产连用）

senses.title: Gain measured against cost
senses.titleCN: 收益相对于投入的比率
senses.definition: the profit or income from an investment stated as a percentage of the amount invested
senses.definitionCN: 投资所得利润或收入占投入金额的百分比
senses.example: The project offers a rate of return of nine percent.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目提供百分之九的回报率。
senses.why: Rate supplies the proportion and return supplies the gain, so the phrase puts one number over another to make them comparable.
senses.whyCN: rate 提供比例，return 提供增益，这个短语把一个数放在另一个数之上，使两者可比。

senses.title: The annualized rate
senses.definition: the rate of return recalculated as if it accrued over one year
senses.definitionCN: 按一年为期限重新折算的回报率
senses.example: The fund reports an annualized rate of return.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金报告的是年化回报率。
senses.why: Periods differ, so the percentage is stretched or compressed to a one-year standard before comparisons are made.
senses.whyCN: 各期长度不同，于是百分比先被拉伸或压缩到一年的标准，再作比较。

senses.title: The minimum acceptable rate
senses.titleCN: 要求达到的最低回报率
senses.definition: the lowest return an investor or firm will accept before committing funds
senses.definitionCN: 投资者或公司在投入资金前愿意接受的最低回报
senses.example: The board set a required rate of return for new plants.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会为新工厂设定了必要回报率。
senses.why: The measure becomes a gate: capital is not released unless the projected percentage clears the threshold.
senses.whyCN: 这个指标变成一道闸门：预期百分比不过门槛，资金就不放行。

senses.title: The internal rate of return
senses.definition: the discount rate at which a project's inflows and outflows have a net present value of zero
senses.definitionCN: 使项目现金流入与流出的净现值为零的折现率
senses.example: The internal rate of return was above the cost of capital.
senses.exampleCN: 内部收益率高于资本成本。
senses.why: Here the rate is solved from the cash flows themselves rather than stated in advance, so the project's own pattern sets the number.
senses.whyCN: 这里的比率由现金流本身解出，而不是事先给定，项目的自身模式决定了这个数字。

senses.title: The real rate after inflation
senses.titleCN: 扣除通胀后的实际回报率
senses.definition: the rate of return adjusted for inflation
senses.definitionCN: 经通胀调整后的回报率
senses.example: A nominal gain can be a negative real rate of return.
senses.exampleCN: 名义上的增益也可能是负的实际回报率。
senses.why: Money gains can shrink in purchasing power, so the measured percentage is corrected to show what it really buys.
senses.whyCN: 金钱上的增益可能被购买力侵蚀，因此测得的百分比要修正，以显示它真正能买到什么。

senses.title: The accounting rate of return
senses.definition: a rate calculated from accounting profit rather than cash flow
senses.definitionCN: 依据会计利润而非现金流计算的比率
senses.example: The accounting rate of return ignores the timing of cash.
senses.exampleCN: 会计收益率忽略现金的时间分布。
senses.why: Different records produce different numbers, so the phrase is qualified by the bookkeeping method that supplies the gain.
senses.whyCN: 不同的账目产生不同的数字，因此这个短语要用提供增益的记账方法来限定。

senses.title: The expected rate
senses.definition: the return an investor anticipates before the outcome is known
senses.definitionCN: 结果未知前投资者预期的回报
senses.example: Investors demand more for a risky expected rate of return.
senses.exampleCN: 投资者对高风险的预期回报要求更高。
senses.why: Before the fact the percentage is a forecast, so the phrase shifts from a realized gain to an anticipated one.
senses.whyCN: 在结果出来之前，百分比是预测，于是这个短语从已实现的增益转到预期的增益。

senses.title: The social rate of return
senses.definition: the return to society from public spending, including benefits not captured in cash
senses.definitionCN: 公共支出给社会带来的回报，包括未以现金体现的益处
senses.example: Vaccination programmes show a high social rate of return.
senses.exampleCN: 疫苗接种项目显示出很高的社会回报率。
senses.why: The gain is widened from private money to public benefit, so the same ratio is applied to health, education and infrastructure.
senses.whyCN: 增益从私人金钱扩大到公共益处，同一个比率于是被用到健康、教育与基础设施上。

intro.en: Rate of return joins rate, from a Latin word for a reckoned share, with return, from a French verb for turning back. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这一短语把「比率」与「回报」两个词组合起来：前者出自拉丁语表示计算出的份额，后者出自法语表示转回去的动词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Reri meant to reckon, think or judge, and it built words about calculation and reason.
items.cn: reri 意为计算、思考、判断，构成了一批表示计算与理性的词。

items.en: Rata pars meant a fixed or reckoned share, and the adjective rata became the English noun rate.
items.cn: rata pars 意为确定或计算出的份额，形容词 rata 后来成为英语名词 rate。

items.en: Rate entered English as a proportion, a standard or a charge fixed by calculation.
items.cn: rate 进入英语时指比例、标准或经计算确定的收费。

items.en: Return took on the sense of the gain that comes back from capital, supplying the second half of the phrase.
items.cn: return 获得「资本带回的增益」这一意义，提供短语的后半。

items.en: Engineers and investors began to compare projects by the percentage that came back each year, fixing rate of return as a technical phrase.
items.cn: 工程师与投资者开始用每年返回的百分比比较项目，回报率这一说法于是固定为专业短语。

items.en: Modern finance multiplied its variants: internal, real, required, expected, accounting and social.
items.cn: 现代金融衍生出许多变体：内部、实际、必要、预期、会计与社会。

note.en: The first group is built from the same reckoning root; the second group contains related measures that answer different questions.
note.cn: 第一组建立在同一个「计算」词根上；第二组是回答不同问题的相关指标。

entries.definition: A proportion or a charge per unit; alone it says nothing about gain, only about a measured relation.
entries.definitionCN: 比例或每单位的收费；单独使用时不表示增益，只表示被衡量的关系。

entries.definition: A relation between two quantities expressed as one divided by the other; a rate of return is one kind of ratio.
entries.definitionCN: 两个数量之间以一个除另一个的关系；回报率是比率的一种。

entries.definition: A fixed allowance of food or supplies; it is a reckoned share, not a financial gain.
entries.definitionCN: 食物或物资的定额；它是计算出的份额，不是金融增益。

entries.definition: Based on reason or calculation; it shares the reckoning root but describes thinking, not returns.
entries.definitionCN: 基于理性或计算的；共享「计算」词根，但描述思维而非回报。

entries.definition: The gain from an investment relative to its cost; it is the broader phrase, while rate of return often appears in project and portfolio arithmetic.
entries.definitionCN: 投资增益相对于成本；它是更宽的说法，而回报率常用于项目与组合计算。

entries.definition: Income from an investment as a percentage, usually ignoring price change; rate of return can include both income and capital gain.
entries.definitionCN: 投资收入以百分比计，通常忽略价格变动；回报率可同时包括收入与资本增值。

entries.definition: The percentage charged for a loan; it is the price of money, not the gain from using it.
entries.definitionCN: 贷款的收费百分比；它是资金的价格，而不是使用资金得到的增益。

entries.definition: The ability of a business to produce profit; it is a quality, while a rate of return is a number.
entries.definitionCN: 企业产生利润的能力；它是性质，而回报率是一个数字。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real reckoning root, the real turning root and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「计算」词根、真实的「转回」词根与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Rate means a reckoned proportion; return means gain coming back; together they put gain over cost.
normal.cn: rate 是算出的比例，return 是转回的增益；合起来就是把增益放在成本之上。

normal.en: The phrase answers one question: for every unit put in, how much comes back?
normal.cn: 这个短语回答一个问题：每投入一个单位，能回来多少？

normal.en: Annual, real, required, expected, internal and social are fixed qualifiers that change the question slightly.
normal.cn: 年度、实际、必要、预期、内部与社会这些固定限定语略微改变问题。

normal.en: Required rate is a gate; internal rate is solved from cash flows; real rate removes inflation.
normal.cn: 必要回报率是闸门；内部收益率由现金流解出；实际回报率扣除通胀。

normal.en: Rate of return is a ratio, so it is always a percentage or a decimal, never a sum of money.
normal.cn: 回报率是一个比率，所以总是百分比或小数，而不是一笔金额。

abstract.en: Picture a balance with cost on one pan and gain on the other, and a small percentage printed where the beam settles.
abstract.cn: 想象一架天平，一端放成本，另一端放增益，横梁停住处印着一个小百分比。

abstract.en: Picture the same percentage stretched over twelve months, then squeezed back for a single quarter.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个百分比被拉到十二个月，再压回一个季度。

abstract.en: Picture a thermometer whose mercury is purchasing power, falling even while the money number rises.
abstract.cn: 想象一支温度计里的水银是购买力，金钱数字上升时它却在下降。

examples.en: The plant achieved a rate of return above the industry average.
examples.cn: 这家工厂的回报率高于行业平均。

examples.en: A negative real rate of return erodes savings silently.
examples.cn: 负的实际回报率在不知不觉中侵蚀储蓄。

examples.en: They rejected the plan because its internal rate of return was too low.
examples.cn: 他们否决了该计划，因为其内部收益率太低。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「回来的比例」——投入一笔钱，看返回来的部分占多少 → 回报率

root: rate 出自拉丁语 rata pars「计算出的份额」，源于 reri「计算、判断」；return 出自法语表示「转回去」的动词。两者合指收益相对于投入的比率。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all express one ratio, then qualify it by time, by threshold, by method, by inflation, by expectation and by who receives the benefit.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都表达同一个比率，再按时间、门槛、方法、通胀、预期与受益者加以限定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a balance with cost on one pan and gain on the other, printing a percentage.
core.cn: 核心意象：一架天平，一端放成本，另一端放增益，并印出一个百分比。

branches.en: BASE RATIO: gain divided by cost gives the plain measure.
branches.cn: 基础比率：增益除以成本，得到最朴素的指标。

branches.en: TIME AND EXPECTATION: the same ratio is annualized, or projected before the outcome is known.
branches.cn: 时间与预期：同一比率被年化，或在结果未知前被预测。

branches.en: THRESHOLD: the ratio becomes a minimum that capital must clear.
branches.cn: 门槛：这个比率成为资金必须越过的下限。

branches.en: METHOD: cash flows solve an internal rate, while accounting profit produces a book rate.
branches.cn: 方法：现金流解出内部收益率，会计利润产生账面收益率。

branches.en: REAL AND SOCIAL: inflation is removed, or private gain is widened to public benefit.
branches.cn: 实际与社会：或扣除通胀，或把私人增益扩大到公共益处。

intro.en: Rate of return is a phrase made of two Latin-derived words, and each brings a family of related terms.
intro.cn: 这一短语由两个拉丁来源词构成，各自带来一族相关词。

latinIntro.en: Latin reri 'to reckon' gives rate, ratio, ration, rational and reason; return comes through French from a Latin turning word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 reri「计算」衍生 rate、ratio、ration、rational 与 reason；return 经法语出自拉丁语表示「转」的词。

definition_zh: 地震学；研究地震与地震波的学科
definition_en: the scientific study of earthquakes and of the waves they send through the earth
core_image: 一间地下观测室里，滚筒纸带不断走动，把来自地底的每一次轻微抖动画成曲线
scene: 大学地质系的地下观测室里，学生围着一台持续走纸的滚筒记录仪。 She chose seismology because she wanted to understand what happens miles below the surface.
sceneCN: 这里 seismology 是「地震学」（第 1 个义项：以地震为研究对象的学科）；句意为她选择地震学，是因为想弄清楚地表以下数英里处发生了什么。

senses.title: The science of earthquakes
senses.definition: the branch of science that studies earthquakes, their causes and their effects
senses.definitionCN: 研究地震、其成因与影响的科学分支
senses.example: She chose seismology because she wanted to understand what happens miles below the surface.
senses.exampleCN: 她选择地震学，是因为想弄清楚地表以下数英里处发生了什么。
senses.why: seismology joins Greek seismos, earthquake, to -logia, the study of something, so the word says exactly what the discipline does.
senses.whyCN: seismology 把希腊 seismos「地震」与 -logia「对某物的研究」拼合，词面正好说出这门学科做什么。

senses.title: The study of seismic waves

senses.definitionCN: 该领域中通过读取岩体中传播的波来推断结构与破裂的部分
senses.example: Modern seismology reads arrivals at hundreds of stations at once.
senses.exampleCN: 现代地震学同时读取数百个台站的到时。
senses.why: earthquakes are known mostly through their waves, so the study of the event became the study of the signal it sends.
senses.whyCN: 地震主要经由其波被认识，因此对事件的研究变成了对它发出的信号的研究。

senses.title: A branch of geophysics
senses.titleCN: 地球物理学的一个分支
senses.definition: the subfield of geophysics that deals with elastic waves and earthquake sources
senses.definitionCN: 地球物理学中处理弹性波与震源问题的子领域
senses.example: Seismology sits beside gravity and magnetism within geophysics.
senses.exampleCN: 在地球物理学中，地震学与重力学、地磁学并列。
senses.why: the discipline defines itself by its physical quantities, and elastic waves are its particular instrument of measurement.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科以所测量的物理量界定自身，而弹性波是它特有的测量手段。

senses.title: Observational network practice
senses.definition: the routine work of operating stations, archiving records and cataloguing events
senses.definitionCN: 运行台站、归档记录与编目事件的日常工作
senses.example: Observational seismology depends on stations that never lose power.
senses.exampleCN: 观测地震学依赖从不掉电的台站。
senses.why: a science built on rare events needs a permanent record, so the adjective observational marks the branch that keeps it.
senses.whyCN: 一门建立在稀有事件上的科学需要永久记录，因此 observational 标出负责保存记录的那一支。

senses.title: Planetary seismology
senses.definition: the application of seismic methods to the Moon, Mars and other solid bodies
senses.definitionCN: 把地震方法用于月球、火星及其他固态天体
senses.example: Planetary seismology detected moonquakes with a single station.
senses.exampleCN: 行星地震学用单个台站探测到了月震。
senses.why: the instrument does not care whether the shaking happens on Earth, so the discipline extended its name to other worlds.
senses.whyCN: 仪器并不在意震动是否发生在地球上，因此这门学科把名字扩展到了别的世界。

senses.title: Exploration seismology
senses.definition: the industrial use of controlled seismic sources to image rock for resources or engineering
senses.definitionCN: 用可控震源为资源或工程目的给岩层成像的工业应用
senses.example: Exploration seismology mapped the reservoir before any well was drilled.
senses.exampleCN: 勘探地震学在任何井开钻之前就勾出了储层。
senses.why: the same theory serves a different goal, so the field is named by its purpose rather than its subject.
senses.whyCN: 同一套理论服务于不同目标，因此这一支按用途而非研究对象命名。

senses.title: Engineering seismology
senses.definition: the branch that estimates ground shaking and supplies design values for structures
senses.definitionCN: 估算地面震动并为结构提供设计参数的分支
senses.example: Engineering seismology turned the fault map into design loads.
senses.exampleCN: 工程地震学把断层图转化为设计荷载。
senses.why: when the question moves from what happened to what to build, the discipline splits off a branch with its own name.
senses.whyCN: 当问题从「发生了什么」转向「该建什么」时，学科便分出一支并另立名目。

senses.title: Historical and computational seismology
senses.titleCN: 历史地震学与计算地震学
senses.definition: the reconstruction of past events from written records, and the numerical modelling of wave propagation
senses.definitionCN: 从文字记录重建过去事件，以及对波传播进行数值模拟
senses.example: Historical seismology pushes the catalogue back three centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 历史地震学把地震目录向前推到三个世纪。
senses.why: both branches work on the same object by other means: one reads old paper, the other runs new code.
senses.whyCN: 两支用不同手段研究同一对象：一支读旧纸，一支跑新代码。

intro.en: Seismology is a modern scientific compound: Greek seismos, earthquake, plus -logia, from logos, word, reason, the study of. It was coined in the nineteenth century and has no Latin ancestor.
intro.cn: seismology 是现代科学复合词：希腊 seismos「地震」加 -logia，后者出自 logos「言说、道理」，意为「对……的研究」。该词于 19 世纪新造，没有拉丁语祖先。

items.en: Seismos meant a shaking or an earthquake, from seiein, to shake. The deeper pre-Greek root is not established and remains reconstructed.
items.cn: seismos 意为震动或地震，来自 seiein「摇动」。其希腊语之前的更深词根未获证明，仍属重构。

items.en: Logos meant word, account or reason; the suffix -logia named the study or account of a subject, as in biology and geology.
items.cn: logos 意为言词、叙述或道理；后缀 -logia 表示对某一主题的研究或叙述，如 biology 与 geology。

items.en: Seismology was formed in English around the 1850s, when earthquake catalogues and instruments made a distinct science possible.
items.cn: seismology 约在 1850 年代在英语中构成，当时地震目录与仪器使一门独立科学成为可能。

items.en: The field split into observational, exploration, engineering and planetary branches as instruments spread and computing arrived.
items.cn: 随着仪器普及与计算技术到来，该领域分成观测、勘探、工程与行星几支。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date and deeper root): the earliest printed use is dated only approximately to the 1850s, and the pre-Greek origin of seiein is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代与更深词根）：最早的印刷用例只能约略定在 1850 年代，seiein 的希腊语之前来源亦无定论。

note.en: Group one holds the instrument-and-person words that cluster around the same stem; group two holds neighbouring earth sciences.
note.cn: 第一组是围绕同一词干的仪器与人名词；第二组是相邻的地球科学学科。

entries.definition: The adjective for anything belonging to seismology, as in a seismological survey or observatory.
entries.definitionCN: 属于地震学的一切事物所用的形容词，如地震学测量或地震观测台。

entries.definition: A person who practises seismology; the -ist suffix marks the practitioner.
entries.definitionCN: 从事地震学的人；-ist 后缀标示从业者。

entries.definition: The measured earthquake activity of a region, not the discipline; it is what seismology studies.
entries.definitionCN: 某地区被测得的地震活动，而非学科本身；它是地震学的研究对象。

entries.definition: The practical method of using elastic waves, especially in exploration; the plural form names a technique, not a science.
entries.definitionCN: 使用弹性波的实用方法，尤用于勘探；复数形式指技术而非学科。

entries.definition: The physics of the whole earth, including gravity, heat and magnetism; seismology is one of its branches.
entries.definitionCN: 研究整个地球物理性质的学科，包括重力、热与磁场；地震学是其分支之一。

entries.definition: The study of rocks, strata and earth history; it overlaps with seismology but does not centre on shaking.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石、地层与地球历史；与地震学有交集，但不以震动为核心。

entries.definition: The study of volcanoes and volcanic activity, often paired with seismology because magma movement causes tremors.
entries.definitionCN: 研究火山与火山活动，常与地震学配对，因为岩浆运移会引发震动。

entries.definition: The measurement of the earth's shape and the movement of its surface, used alongside seismic data to track deformation.
entries.definitionCN: 测量地球形状与地表运动，常与地震数据配合追踪形变。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: seismo-, earthquake, plus -logy, study of: the study of earthquakes.
normal.cn: seismo-「地震」加 -logy「研究」：研究地震的学问。

normal.en: The family runs seismology, seismologist, seismological, seismically, seismicity.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 seismology、seismologist、seismological、seismically、seismicity。

normal.en: Instruments mark the field: seismograph, seismometer, seismogram all begin with seismo-.
normal.cn: 仪器标记这门学科：seismograph、seismometer、seismogram 都以 seismo- 开头。

normal.en: Fixed branches: observational, exploration, engineering and planetary seismology.
normal.cn: 固定分支：观测地震学、勘探地震学、工程地震学、行星地震学。

normal.en: -logy words name disciplines, so seismology is the discipline, not an instrument or a person.
normal.cn: -logy 结尾的词命名学科，因此 seismology 是学科，不是仪器或人。

abstract.en: Picture a doctor listening through the ground instead of through a chest.
abstract.cn: 想象一位医生不是听诊胸腔，而是隔着大地听诊。

abstract.en: Picture a library that shelves not books but wobbling lines of ink.
abstract.cn: 想象一座图书馆，架上放的不是书，而是抖动的墨线。

abstract.en: Picture a language in which the only sentence is a wave arriving at a certain hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一种语言，其中唯一的句子就是某时到达的一道波。

examples.en: Seismology advanced quickly once stations could share timing signals.
examples.cn: 台站能共享授时信号之后，地震学迅速进步。

examples.en: Her textbook on seismology is used in both geology and physics departments.
examples.cn: 她的地震学教材同时被地质系与物理系采用。

examples.en: Planetary seismology may yet reveal a liquid core inside Mars.
examples.cn: 行星地震学也许终将揭示火星内部的液态核。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「seismo（地震）+ logy（学科）」——研究地震的学问 → 地震学

root: 希腊 seismos「地震」+ -logia（出自 logos「言说、道理」）→ seismologia 式复合；英语 seismology。希腊来源，无拉丁同族，拉丁词条留空。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses trace one discipline outward: the science of earthquakes, its waves, its parent field, its network work, and then its planetary, industrial, engineering, historical and computational branches.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项由一门学科向外展开：地震的科学、它的波、它的母学科、它的台网工作，再到行星、工业、工程、历史与计算各分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a paper drum turning slowly, drawing every tremor as a line.
core.cn: 核心意象：纸鼓缓慢转动，把每一次微震画成一条线。

branches.en: THE SCIENCE: the name points at the discipline as a whole.
branches.cn: 学科整体：名称首先指向这门学问全体。

branches.en: THE METHOD: waves are the instrument, geophysics the frame.
branches.cn: 方法：波是工具，地球物理学是框架。

branches.en: THE RECORD: permanent stations turn rare events into data.
branches.cn: 记录：永久台站把稀有事件变成数据。

branches.en: OTHER BODIES AND OTHER GOALS: the same method leaves Earth or leaves pure research.
branches.cn: 别的天体与别的目标：同一方法离开地球，或离开纯研究。

branches.en: SERVICE AND RECONSTRUCTION: it supplies design loads and rebuilds the past.
branches.cn: 服务与重建：它提供设计荷载，也重建过去。

intro.en: Seismology is a transparent Greek compound: an earthquake stem at the front and a study suffix at the back.
intro.cn: seismology 是一个透明的希腊复合词：前部是「地震」词干，后部是「研究」后缀。

latinIntro.en: Nothing here is Latin: both halves are Greek, and Latin only enters later as the language of scientific publication.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁成分：前后两半都是希腊语，拉丁语只是后来作为科学出版语言进入。

items.example: Seismo- opens both science and instrument names.
items.exampleCN: seismo- 既开启学科名，也开启仪器名。

items.example: The stem is borrowed whole from Greek.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干整体借自希腊语。

items.example: -Logy builds names of disciplines.
items.exampleCN: -logy 构成学科名称。

items.example: Logos supplies the suffix -logy.
items.exampleCN: logos 提供了后缀 -logy。

items.example: Seismology is taught in the earth sciences building.
items.exampleCN: 地震学在地球科学楼里授课。

items.example: The seismologist read the record at a glance.
items.exampleCN: 地震学家一眼就读懂了记录。

items.example: The seismological observatory never closes.
items.exampleCN: 地震观测台从不关闭。

items.example: The seismogram is stored digitally now.
items.exampleCN: 地震记录图如今以数字方式保存。

items.example: The seismograph was invented in the nineteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 地震仪发明于 19 世纪。

items.meaning: an instrument that measures ground motion
items.example: A broadband seismometer detects distant quakes.
items.exampleCN: 宽频地震计能探测远处的地震。

definition_zh: 汇聚；趋同；收敛；会聚
definition_en: the process of moving towards the same point, or of becoming more alike
core_image: 两条山脊上的小路越走越近，最后在山口汇成一条
scene: 两条山路从不同方向爬上山脊，越靠近山顶越窄，最后在山口合成一条。 The two trails show a clear convergence at the ridge.
sceneCN: 这里指两条路线向同一点收拢（第 1 个义项：汇聚）；句意为两条小径在山脊明显汇聚。图中可辨识物件：山脊、两条小路、路口标桩、路牌。

pos.zh: 名词：汇聚；趋同；收敛；会聚（不可数，指具体汇合处时可数）

derivatives.zh: 同一词根的动词，义为「汇聚；趋同；收敛」
由该动词加形容词词尾构成，义为「汇聚的；趋同的」
由该形容词加副词词尾构成，义为「以趋同方式」
由表示「分开」的前缀加同一词根构成，义为「分叉；分歧」
由该词根加「分开」前缀与形容词词尾构成，义为「分叉的；有分歧的」

senses.title: Lines moving towards one point
senses.definition: the coming together of lines, paths or streams towards a single point
senses.definitionCN: 线条、路径或水流向单一一点靠拢
senses.example: The two trails show a clear convergence at the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 两条小径在山脊明显汇聚。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to bend together, so two lines bend until they meet.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「一起弯」，两条线因此弯到相遇。

senses.title: People or interests coming together
senses.definition: the process by which separate groups or interests move towards a shared position
senses.definitionCN: 分开的群体或利益向共同立场靠拢的过程
senses.example: The convergence of the two campaigns surprised observers.
senses.exampleCN: 两场运动的趋同让观察者意外。
senses.why: Social convergence borrows the geometry: separate paths end at one point of agreement.
senses.whyCN: 社会领域的趋同借了几何：分开的路径最后落在同一个共识点。

senses.title: Technological and media convergence
senses.definition: the merging of previously separate technologies, industries or media into one platform
senses.definitionCN: 原先分开的技术、产业或媒介合并到同一平台
senses.example: Technological convergence put a camera, a phone and a library in one device.
senses.exampleCN: 技术融合把相机、电话与书库放进同一台设备。
senses.why: When separate streams share one channel, the image of water meeting is exact.
senses.whyCN: 当分开的溪流共用一条水道，水流相会的意象正好贴切。

senses.title: Evolutionary convergence
senses.definition: the independent development of similar traits in unrelated species
senses.definitionCN: 不相关物种独立演化出相似特征
senses.example: Convergence explains why unrelated animals both developed wings.
senses.exampleCN: 趋同演化解释了不相关的动物为何都长出翅膀。
senses.why: Unrelated lineages facing the same problem take the same shape, which is convergence without shared ancestry.
senses.whyCN: 不相关的谱系面对同一难题会长出同一形状，这就是没有共同祖先的趋同。

senses.title: Economic convergence
senses.definition: the narrowing of income or growth gaps between regions or countries
senses.definitionCN: 地区或国家之间收入或增长差距缩小
senses.example: The bloc reported economic convergence over the past decade.
senses.exampleCN: 该联盟报告过去十年出现经济趋同。
senses.why: Economies that grow at similar rates draw level, as two paths arriving at one height.
senses.whyCN: 增长速度相近的经济体会拉平，就像两条路径到达同一高度。

senses.title: Mathematical convergence
senses.definition: the property of a sequence or series approaching a fixed limit
senses.definitionCN: 数列或级数趋近某个固定极限的性质
senses.example: The proof establishes the convergence of the series.
senses.exampleCN: 这个证明确立了该级数的收敛。
senses.why: Mathematics turned the everyday image of approach into a precise limit.
senses.whyCN: 数学把「靠近」的日常意象变成了精确的极限。

senses.title: Convergence of opinions
senses.definition: the process by which views move closer after discussion
senses.definitionCN: 讨论之后看法逐渐靠近的过程
senses.example: Repeated deliberation produced a convergence of expert opinion.
senses.exampleCN: 反复讨论使专家意见趋于一致。
senses.why: Agreement is treated as a meeting point that independent views reach from different sides.
senses.whyCN: 共识被看作独立意见从不同方向到达的汇合点。

senses.title: Convergence in meteorology
senses.definition: the meeting of air flows that forces air upward and can produce weather
senses.definitionCN: 气流的汇合，把空气抬升并可能产生天气现象
senses.example: Forecasters watched the convergence of the two air masses.
senses.exampleCN: 预报员关注两股气团的辐合。
senses.why: Air that meets cannot go down, so it rises, cools and forms cloud, which is why the word matters in forecasting.
senses.whyCN: 相遇的空气无法下沉，只能抬升、冷却并成云，这个词因此在预报里很重要。

senses.title: Convergence of the eyes
senses.definition: the inward turning of the eyes to focus on a near object
senses.definitionCN: 双眼向内转动以聚焦近处物体
senses.example: Reading at close range requires convergence of the eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 近距离阅读需要双眼会聚。
senses.why: Both eyes must point at one near point, which is the same geometry applied to vision.
senses.whyCN: 双眼必须对准同一个近点，这是同一套几何用在视觉上。

intro.en: Convergence comes from Latin convergere, to bend together, built from con-, together, and vergere, to bend or turn. The noun passed through French into English in the eighteenth century, first for lines and later for ideas and economies.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 convergere「一起弯曲」，由表示「共同」的前缀与表示「弯曲、转向」的词根构成。名词经法语在十八世纪进入英语，先用于线，后用于观念与经济。

items.en: The verb meant to bend, turn or incline, and it also stands behind diverge and verge.
items.cn: 这个动词意为弯曲、转向、倾斜，也是「分叉」与「边缘」等词的源头。

items.en: The prefix meant together, and it makes two inclinations meet.
items.cn: 这个前缀意为共同，使两个倾斜方向相遇。

items.en: The compound meant to incline towards one point or to come together.
items.cn: 这个复合动词意为朝一点倾斜或合到一起。

items.en: The noun named the state of tending towards one point.
items.cn: 这个名词指朝一点靠拢的状态。

items.en: French carried the word into English, first in geometry and optics.
items.cn: 法语把这个词带进英语，最初用于几何与光学。

items.en: Later usage extended it to opinions, economies, media and biology.
items.cn: 后来的用法把它扩展到意见、经济、媒介与生物学。

note.en: The first group shares the root or its opposite; the second group names other kinds of coming together.
note.cn: 第一组共享词根或其反义形式；第二组是其他「合到一起」的说法。

entries.definition: The verb for moving towards one point.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，指向一点靠拢。

entries.definition: The adjective describing things that meet.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容汇合之物。

entries.definition: In a manner that moves towards a point.
entries.definitionCN: 指以靠拢的方式。

entries.definition: The noun for moving apart, the mirror image.
entries.definitionCN: 指分开的名词，是镜像概念。

entries.definition: The adjective for paths that spread apart.
entries.definitionCN: 形容路径分开的形容词。

entries.definition: The act of joining into one body.
entries.definitionCN: 指合并为一的过程。

entries.definition: The act of making separate parts into one.
entries.definitionCN: 指把分开的部分合成一个。

entries.definition: Bringing things into a shared line or position.
entries.definitionCN: 指把事物排到同一条线上。

entries.definition: Movement towards a value without reaching it exactly.
entries.definitionCN: 指向某值接近而未必达到。

entries.definition: A gap becoming smaller over time.
entries.definitionCN: 指差距随时间缩小。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the image of two lines bending towards each other, then apply it to ideas, markets and numbers.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用两条线向彼此弯曲的意象，再把它用到观念、市场与数字上。

normal.en: The root verb means to bend, so two paths bend until they meet at the ridge.
normal.cn: 词根意为弯曲，所以两条路径弯到在山脊相遇。

normal.en: Technological convergence puts a camera and a library in the same device.
normal.cn: 技术融合把相机和书库放进同一台设备。

normal.en: Convergent evolution explains why unrelated animals both grew wings.
normal.cn: 趋同演化解释不相关的动物为何都长出翅膀。

normal.en: A convergent series in mathematics approaches a limit without necessarily reaching it.
normal.cn: 数学中的收敛级数趋近极限，但未必到达。

normal.en: Forecasters speak of the convergence of air masses, where rising air makes weather.
normal.cn: 预报员说气团辐合，那里上升空气制造天气。

abstract.en: Two paths that never touch still share a horizon, and the word names that horizon.
abstract.cn: 两条永不相交的路径仍共有一个地平线，这个词给那条地平线命名。

abstract.en: Agreement is not sameness: converging views keep their starting points.
abstract.cn: 趋同不等于同一：靠拢的看法仍各自保留出发点。

abstract.en: Every meeting point is also a place where differences become invisible.
abstract.cn: 每个汇合点也是差异变得看不见的地方。

examples.en: The convergence of the two rivers created a natural harbour.
examples.cn: 两条河的汇合形成了一处天然港。

examples.en: Economic convergence between the regions took twenty years.
examples.cn: 两地区之间的经济趋同花了二十年。

examples.en: The paper examines convergence in the fossil record.
examples.cn: 这篇论文考察化石记录中的趋同现象。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「康弗真斯」——两条路越走越近，最后收到一个点上，就是「汇聚、趋同」：汇聚、趋同、收敛

root: 来自拉丁语 convergere「一起弯曲」，由 con-「共同」与 vergere「弯曲、转向」构成；名词经法语在十八世纪进入英语，先用于几何与光学，后扩展到意见、经济、媒介与生物。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses let separate lines, groups, technologies, species, economies, series, opinions, air flows and eyes move towards one point.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项让分开的线、群体、技术、物种、经济体、级数、意见、气流与双眼向同一个点靠拢。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two trails climbing one ridge from opposite sides, narrowing until they meet at the pass.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条小径从两侧爬上山脊，越走越窄，最后在山口汇合。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL MEETING: paths, air flows and eyes turn towards one point.
branches.cn: 物理汇合：路径、气流与双眼都转向同一点。

branches.en: THE SHARED POSITION: groups and opinions move towards agreement.
branches.cn: 共享立场：群体与意见向共识靠拢。

branches.en: THE SHARED PLATFORM: separate technologies merge into one device.
branches.cn: 共享平台：分开的技术并入同一台设备。

branches.en: THE SHARED TRAIT: unrelated species evolve similar forms.
branches.cn: 共享特征：不相关物种演化出相似形态。

branches.en: THE SHARED LEVEL AND LIMIT: economies draw level, series approach a limit.
branches.cn: 共享水平与极限：经济体拉平，级数趋近极限。

intro.en: The word is a Latin verb of bending with a prefix of togetherness, so its core is two slopes meeting.
intro.cn: 这个词是表示弯曲的拉丁动词加上表示共同的前缀，核心就是两道斜坡相遇。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the verb of bending, the prefix, the compound verb and the noun of tendency.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了表示弯曲的动词、前缀、复合动词与表示趋向的名词。

items.example: It also stands behind diverge.
items.exampleCN: 它也是「分叉」一词的源头。

items.example: It makes two bends meet.
items.exampleCN: 它让两道弯曲相遇。

items.example: The verb is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是英语词的直接源头。

items.example: The noun named the tendency.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指这种趋向。

items.example: The verb keeps the image of bending lines.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词保留弯线的意象。

items.example: The adjective adds a Latin ending.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词加了拉丁词尾。

items.example: It forms the abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 它构成抽象名词。

items.example: It marks the participle-like adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它标记类似分词的形容词。

items.example: It forms the mirror word divergence.
items.exampleCN: 它构成镜像词「分叉」。

items.example: It forms the adverb.
items.exampleCN: 它构成副词。

加形容词词尾构成，义为「汇聚的」
加副词词尾构成，义为「以趋同方式」

definition_zh: 王朝；同一家族世代相继的统治；某王朝统治的时期；世代传承的大家族或企业；长期称霸的队伍
definition_en: a succession of rulers from the same family, the period of their rule, and by extension any powerful family or dominant group that lasts for generations
core_image: 一条族谱横贯数代画像，每幅画像手里都握着同一枚印玺
scene: 祠堂的墙上挂着十几幅画像，面容不同，手中都握着同一枚印。 The dynasty ruled for three hundred years before the last heir died childless.
sceneCN: 这里 dynasty 指「同一家族世代相继的统治」（第 1 个义项：权力在同一血脉内传递）；句意为这个王朝统治三百年，直到最后一位继承人无子而终。可辨识物件：祠堂、画像、族谱、印玺、蜡烛。

pos.zh: 王朝；王朝统治期；世家；长期称霸的团队

derivatives.zh: dynasty + -ic（形容词后缀，经拉丁 -icus、希腊 -ikos）→ 王朝的，语义由家族名转为属性
dynastic + -ally（副词后缀）→ 以王朝、世袭方式地
希腊 dynastes 经拉丁 dynasta → 王朝君主、世袭统治者，语义由抽象统治转为具体的人
dynastic + -ism（体系后缀）→ 王朝主义、以世袭家族为中心的政治（较少用）

senses.title: A ruling family succeeding itself
senses.titleCN: 同一家族世代相继的统治
senses.definition: a line of rulers drawn from one family and following one another by inheritance
senses.definitionCN: 出自同一家族、依继承顺序相继即位的一连串统治者
senses.example: The dynasty ruled for three hundred years before the last heir died childless.
senses.exampleCN: 这个王朝统治了三百年，直到最后一位继承人无子而终。
senses.why: Greek dynasteia named lordship itself, and English narrowed it to a family's continuous hold on power.
senses.whyCN: 希腊 dynasteia 本指领主统治，英语把它收窄为一个家族对权力的连续掌握。

senses.title: The period of a family's rule
senses.definition: the span of time during which one ruling family held power, used as a historical period
senses.definitionCN: 一个统治家族掌权的时段，用作历史分期
senses.example: Most of the canal was dug during the dynasty.
senses.exampleCN: 这条运河的大部分是在该王朝时期开凿的。
senses.why: A ruling house marks time so strongly that its name becomes a period label, as in 'Tang poetry'.
senses.whyCN: 统治家族对时间的标记如此强烈，其名便成为时期标签，如「唐诗」。

senses.title: A family business carried through generations
senses.definition: a family that controls a business or fortune across several generations
senses.definitionCN: 连续数代控制一家企业或一笔家产的家族
senses.example: The dynasty of shipbuilders lasted five generations.
senses.exampleCN: 这个造船世家延续了五代。
senses.why: The political model was transferred to commerce: inheritance and continuity matter more than any single owner.
senses.whyCN: 政治模型被移到商业上：继承与延续比任何单一所有者都重要。

senses.title: A political family
senses.definition: a family that holds public office or party power across generations
senses.definitionCN: 连续数代掌握公职或政党权力的家族
senses.example: A political dynasty held the mayor's office for decades.
senses.exampleCN: 一个政治世家把市长职位握了几十年。
senses.why: Elections do not prevent the same surname from recurring, so the hereditary image fits modern politics too.
senses.whyCN: 选举并不能阻止同一个姓氏反复出现，因此世袭意象也适用于现代政治。

senses.title: A team that dominates a sport
senses.titleCN: 长期称霸某运动的队伍
senses.definition: a sports team that wins championships repeatedly over a long stretch
senses.definitionCN: 在很长一段时期内反复夺冠的运动队
senses.example: The club became a dynasty by winning six titles in eight years.
senses.exampleCN: 这家俱乐部八年内六次夺冠，成为一个王朝。
senses.why: American sports writing borrowed the word for uninterrupted excellence, keeping the sense of succession without a crown.
senses.whyCN: 美国体育写作借这个词形容不间断的卓越，保留了「相继」之意，却不再有王冠。

senses.title: A named house used as a period label
senses.titleCN: 作为历史分期名称的具名王朝
senses.definition: the proper name of a ruling house used to divide history into eras
senses.definitionCN: 统治家族的专名，被用来把历史划分为若干时期
senses.example: Scholars divide the era by dynasty rather than by century.
senses.exampleCN: 学者按王朝而非世纪来划分这个时代。
senses.why: Where one family ruled long enough, its name became the standard unit of chronology.
senses.whyCN: 当一个家族统治足够久，其名便成为年代学的标准单位。

senses.title: A line of artists or craftsmen
senses.titleCN: 世代相传的艺人或工匠世家
senses.definition: a family whose members carry on the same art or craft over several generations
senses.definitionCN: 家族成员连续数代从事同一门艺术或手艺
senses.example: A dynasty of violin makers trained every apprentice in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 一个制琴世家训练了山谷里所有的学徒。
senses.why: Craft succession copies biological succession: the workshop passes like a throne.
senses.whyCN: 手艺的传承模仿血脉的传承：作坊像王位一样传下去。

senses.title: A bloodline traced through generations
senses.definition: a family line itself, considered as a continuous descent rather than as rulers
senses.definitionCN: 家族血脉本身，被视为连续世系而非统治者
senses.example: The genealogy traces the dynasty back to a single magistrate.
senses.exampleCN: 这份族谱把这个家族一直追溯到一位地方官。
senses.why: Before it meant rulers, the Greek word meant lordship; the family line is the substratum that carries the office.
senses.whyCN: 在指统治者之前，这个希腊词指领主身份；家族血脉是承载职位的底层。

intro.en: Dynasty comes through Latin and French from Greek dynasteia 'lordship, rule', built on dynastes 'lord' and dynasthai 'to be able, to have power'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: dynasty 经拉丁与法语来自希腊 dynasteia「领主统治」，由 dynastes「领主」与 dynasthai「能够、有权力」构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Dynasthai meant 'to be able, to have power'; it is related to dynamis 'power', the source of dynamic and dynamo.
items.cn: dynasthai 意为「能够、拥有权力」，与 dynamis「力量」同源，后者是 dynamic 与 dynamo 的来源。

items.en: The agent noun dynastes named a lord or ruler, literally one who has power.
items.cn: 施动名词 dynastes 指领主或统治者，字面就是「有权力的人」。

items.en: The abstract noun dynasteia named lordship or rule, and it is this form that passed into Latin.
items.cn: 抽象名词 dynasteia 指领主统治，进入拉丁语的正是这一形式。

items.en: Latin dynastia and French dynastie carried the word westward; English had it by the late fourteenth century.
items.cn: 拉丁 dynastia 与法语 dynastie 把这个词向西传；英语在十四世纪后期已有此词。

items.en: The business sense is nineteenth-century, and the sports sense is twentieth-century American usage; both keep the idea of unbroken succession.
items.cn: 商业义出现于十九世纪，体育义是二十世纪美国用法；两者都保留「不间断相继」的观念。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first English citation is not established, and the precise relationship between dynasthai and dynamis is accepted in outline but not documented in every detail.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：确切的最早英语书证未有定论；dynasthai 与 dynamis 的关系在大体上被接受，但细节并非全部有据。

note.en: Group one holds forms from the same Greek root or accidental neighbours; group two holds words for a continuous ruling line.
note.cn: 第一组是同出希腊词根或偶然相邻的形式；第二组是表示连续统治世系的词。

entries.definition: The adjective of dynasty, from Greek dynastikos through Latin dynasticus.
entries.definitionCN: dynasty 的形容词，经拉丁 dynasticus 出自希腊 dynastikos。

entries.definition: A ruler or member of a ruling family, from Greek dynastes; it names the person, not the line.
entries.definitionCN: 统治者或统治家族成员，出自希腊 dynastes；指人而非世系。

entries.definition: From Greek dynamis 'power', a cousin of dynasthai: it means full of force or change, not hereditary rule.
entries.definitionCN: 出自希腊 dynamis「力量」，与 dynasthai 同族：意为充满力量或变化的，与世袭统治无关。

entries.definition: A machine that generates current, named from dynamis 'power'; it shares the power root but not the political sense.
entries.definitionCN: 发电机的名称，取自动力之义；共享「力量」词根，但无政治义。

entries.definition: A royal or noble family, as in the House of Habsburg; it stresses lineage and alliance rather than a sequence of rulers.
entries.definitionCN: 王室或贵族家族，如哈布斯堡家族；侧重血脉与联姻，而非统治者序列。

entries.definition: A continuous descent from an ancestor; it can describe any family, not only one that rules.
entries.definitionCN: 自某一祖先传下的连续血脉；可指任何家族，不限统治家族。

entries.definition: A particular government or system; it need not be hereditary and usually names the arrangement, not the family.
entries.definitionCN: 特定的政府或制度；不必世袭，通常指制度安排而非家族。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for relatives; it lacks the political sense of inherited rule that dynasty carries.
entries.definitionCN: 指亲属的日常词；不含 dynasty 那种继承统治的政治含义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Greek dynasthai 'have power' + -eia: a body of power held in one line.
normal.cn: 希腊 dynasthai「拥有权力」+ -eia：握在一条世系里的权力。

normal.en: The family runs dynasty, dynastic, dynast, dynastically.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 dynasty、dynastic、dynast、dynastically。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: the Tang dynasty, a ruling dynasty, found a dynasty.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：唐朝、统治王朝、建立王朝。

normal.en: dynamic and dynamo share the power root dynamis but not the political sense.
normal.cn: dynamic 与 dynamo 共享 dynamis 这一「力量」词根，但无政治义。

normal.en: The same word covers a shipbuilding family and a championship team.
normal.cn: 同一个词既能指造船世家，也能指夺冠球队。

abstract.en: Picture a family portrait where every face holds the same seal.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅全家福，每张脸都握着同一枚印。

abstract.en: Picture a relay race in which the baton is a crown.
abstract.cn: 想象一场接力赛，接力棒是一顶王冠。

abstract.en: Picture a workshop sign repainted with the same surname for five generations.
abstract.cn: 想象一块作坊招牌，同一个姓氏被重描了五代。

examples.en: The last dynasty fell after a decade of harvest failures.
examples.cn: 最后一个王朝在连续十年歉收后覆灭。

examples.en: The museum labels the pottery by dynasty and by kiln.
examples.cn: 博物馆按王朝与窑口给这些陶器贴标签。

examples.en: A banking dynasty survived three financial crises by staying private.
examples.cn: 一个银行世家靠保持私有挺过了三次金融危机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「dynasty」音近「代那事体」——一代接一代都办同一件事：坐江山 → 王朝

root: 希腊 dynasteia「领主统治」= dynastes「领主」+ -eia（抽象名词后缀）；dynastes 出自 dynasthai「拥有权力」，与 dynamis「力量」同源。经拉丁 dynastia、法语 dynastie 入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one bloodline: a family hands power downward. The line becomes a period, a firm, a party, a team, a craft and finally a genealogy.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一条血脉展开：一个家族把权力往下传。这条线依次成为时期、企业、政党、球队、手艺，最后成为族谱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a family tree laid across a row of portraits, each hand holding the same seal.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条族谱横贯一排画像，每只手都握着同一枚印。

branches.en: THE LINE: ancestry is the channel through which power passes.
branches.cn: 血脉：祖先世系是权力传递的通道。

branches.en: THE PERIOD: a long-ruling house becomes a unit of chronology.
branches.cn: 时期：长期统治的家族成为年代单位。

branches.en: THE FAMILY HOLDING: commerce and politics inherit the hereditary pattern.
branches.cn: 家族把持：商业与政治都继承了世袭模式。

branches.en: THE TEAM: sport keeps the succession but drops the crown.
branches.cn: 球队：体育保留了「相继」，去掉了王冠。

branches.en: THE CRAFT: a workshop can pass like a throne.
branches.cn: 手艺：作坊也能像王位一样传下去。

intro.en: Dynasty is a Greek noun that came west through Latin and French; its root and suffix also build dynast, dynastic and dynamic, so the family can be read morpheme by morpheme.
intro.cn: dynasty 是经拉丁与法语西传的希腊名词；其词根与后缀也构成 dynast、dynastic 与 dynamic，因此整个词族可按语素逐个读出。

latinIntro.en: Greek dynasthai and dynastes give dynast and dynasty; Latin dynastia passed into French dynastie and then English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 dynasthai 与 dynastes 衍生 dynast 与 dynasty；拉丁 dynastia 传入法语 dynastie，再进入英语。

items.structure: dynasthai (Greek verb, 'to be able, to have power')
items.example: The root ties ruling to the idea of being able.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把统治与「有能力」联系起来。

items.example: The suffix makes a person out of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成人。

items.example: A dynastes held power by inheritance.
items.exampleCN: 领主凭继承掌握权力。

items.example: The suffix turns the ruler into the institution of rule.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把统治者转为统治制度。

items.example: Lordship passed from father to son.
items.exampleCN: 领主之位由父传子。

items.example: The suffix built dynastic from dynasty.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀由 dynasty 构成 dynastic。

items.structure: dynasteia, through Latin dynastia and French dynastie
items.example: The dynasty ruled for three centuries.
items.exampleCN: 这个王朝统治了三个世纪。

items.example: Dynastic marriage joined two crowns.
items.exampleCN: 王朝联姻把两顶王冠连在一起。

items.example: The last dynast abdicated.
items.exampleCN: 最后一位世袭君主退位了。

items.example: The market was dynamic and unpredictable.
items.exampleCN: 市场充满活力且难以预测。

definition_zh: 海洋污染；海洋污染物输入；陆源污染；油污；塑料污染；营养盐污染；海洋噪声污染
definition_en: the introduction into the sea of substances, energy or organisms that harm marine life, ecosystems or human uses
core_image: 河口外的海面浮着一层油膜，塑料碎片与泡沫混在浪花里
scene: 志愿者在河口外的沙滩上捡起缠着海草的塑料瓶，远处的海面泛着一层油光。 Marine pollution reaches even the deepest trenches through currents and sinking particles.
sceneCN: 这里指「进入海洋并造成危害的物质或能量」（第 1 个义项：人类活动把污染物排入海中、损害生命与生态系统的总过程）；句意为海洋污染经由洋流与下沉颗粒，连最深的海沟也能到达。场景物件：塑料瓶、海草、油膜、浪花。

forms.label: 相关形容词（造成污染的）

senses.title: Contamination of the sea
senses.definition: the introduction into the sea of substances, energy or organisms that harm marine life, ecosystems or human uses
senses.definitionCN: 人类把物质、能量或生物引入海中，损害海洋生命、生态系统或人类用途
senses.example: Marine pollution reaches even the deepest trenches through currents and sinking particles.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋污染经由洋流与下沉颗粒，连最深的海沟也能到达。
senses.why: Marine fixes the setting and pollution names the making-impure, so the phrase is the whole range of harmful inputs to the sea.
senses.whyCN: marine 固定场景，pollution 指使变脏，因此这个短语是进入海洋的全部有害输入。

senses.title: Land-based runoff
senses.definition: pollution carried from land by rivers, drains and groundwater
senses.definitionCN: 经河流、排水管与地下水从陆地带来的污染
senses.example: Most marine pollution begins on land, far from the beach.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分海洋污染始于陆地，离海滩很远。
senses.why: Because most inputs come downhill from cities and farms, the phrase often means the land-based share.
senses.whyCN: 因为大部分输入从城市与农场顺流而下，这个短语常指陆源那一部分。

senses.title: Oil spills
senses.definition: crude oil or fuel released from tankers, pipelines or wells into the sea
senses.definitionCN: 油轮、管道或油井把原油或燃料泄入海中
senses.example: Marine pollution from the spill coated the birds for months.
senses.exampleCN: 溢油造成的海洋污染给鸟身上裹了好几个月的油。
senses.why: Oil is the most visible input, so the phrase became a familiar label for tanker and rig disasters.
senses.whyCN: 石油是最显眼的输入，因此这个短语成了油轮与钻井事故的常用标签。

senses.title: Plastics and microplastics
senses.definition: plastic debris, pellets and fragments that persist and accumulate in the sea
senses.definitionCN: 在海中持久存在并累积的塑料垃圾、颗粒与碎片
senses.example: Marine pollution is now dominated by plastic by count.
senses.exampleCN: 按数量计，海洋污染如今以塑料为主。
senses.why: As plastic production grew, the phrase shifted toward the most numerous and durable debris.
senses.whyCN: 随着塑料产量增长，这个短语转向数量最多、最持久的垃圾。

senses.title: Nutrient overload
senses.definition: excess nitrogen and phosphorus that fuel algal blooms and low-oxygen dead zones
senses.definitionCN: 过量氮磷引发藻华与低氧死区
senses.example: Marine pollution from fertilizer created a dead zone at the river mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 化肥造成的海洋污染在河口造出一片死区。
senses.why: The harm here is too much food rather than poison, so the phrase includes enrichment as a form of pollution.
senses.whyCN: 这里的危害是「食物太多」而非毒物，因此这个短语把富营养化也算作污染。

senses.title: Chemical contaminants
senses.definition: heavy metals, persistent organic pollutants and industrial chemicals that accumulate in tissue
senses.definitionCN: 在组织中累积的重金属、持久性有机污染物与工业化学品
senses.example: Marine pollution shows up as mercury in top predators.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋污染在顶级捕食者体内表现为汞。
senses.why: When contaminants travel through food chains and concentrate, the phrase names that chemical load.
senses.whyCN: 当污染物沿食物链传递并富集，这个短语就指这份化学负荷。

senses.title: Underwater noise
senses.definition: sound from ships, sonar and construction that disrupts marine animals
senses.definitionCN: 船只、声呐与施工产生的、干扰海洋动物的声音
senses.example: Marine pollution now includes noise that drowns out whale calls.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋污染如今也包括淹没鲸歌的噪声。
senses.why: Modern law treats energy as a pollutant, so the phrase extends from matter to sound.
senses.whyCN: 现代法律把能量也视为污染物，因此这个短语从物质延伸到声音。

senses.title: A legal definition
senses.definition: the treaty definition of harmful input that states must prevent and control
senses.definitionCN: 条约中对各国有义务预防与控制的有害输入所作的定义
senses.example: The convention defines marine pollution by its effects, not by its source.
senses.exampleCN: 该公约按影响而非来源定义海洋污染。
senses.why: Once treaties needed a shared test, the phrase became a term of law with a precise scope.
senses.whyCN: 当条约需要共同的判定标准，这个短语就成了范围精确的法律术语。

intro.en: Marine pollution joins Latin marinus 'of the sea' with Latin polluere 'to defile', whose deeper history is not fully settled. The phrase is a modern legal and scientific collocation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: marine pollution 把拉丁 marinus「海的」与拉丁 polluere「弄脏、亵渎」并置，后者更深的历史并无定论。这个短语是近代法律与科学搭配。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mare 'sea' gave marinus 'of the sea', borrowed into English as marine; the deeper origin of mare is uncertain.
items.cn: mare「海」形成 marinus「海的」，借入英语作 marine；mare 的更深来源不确定。

items.en: Polluere meant 'to defile, contaminate'; it is often analysed as a prefix plus a washing root, but the details are disputed.
items.cn: polluere 意为「弄脏、污染」；常被分析为前缀加「洗」的词根，但具体细节有争议。

items.en: English pollution first meant moral defilement before it came to mean physical contamination.
items.cn: 英语 pollution 最初指道德上的玷污，后来才指物理污染。

items.en: Marine was attached once pollution law needed to separate the sea from rivers and air.
items.cn: 当污染法需要把海洋与河流、空气分开，marine 便被加在前面。

items.en: Mid-century oil-spill treaties made marine pollution a standard legal term with duties to prevent and control.
items.cn: 二十世纪中叶的溢油条约使 marine pollution 成为带有预防与控制义务的标准法律术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Latin source of mare is unknown, the internal history of polluere is disputed, and the first use of the exact phrase is not precisely dated.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：mare 在拉丁语之前的来源不明，polluere 的内部历史有争议，确切短语最早的用法没有精确年代。

note.en: Group one holds the same-root pollution family; group two holds specific marine impacts often used as if they were synonyms.
note.cn: 第一组是同根 pollution 词族；第二组是常被当作同义词使用的具体海洋影响。

entries.definition: Contamination of any environment; marine pollution restricts it to the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 任何环境的污染；marine pollution 把它限定到海洋。

entries.definition: To make something impure; it names the act, while marine pollution names the resulting condition.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物变脏；它指行为，而 marine pollution 指由此形成的状态。

entries.definition: A specific contaminating substance; marine pollution is the whole input and its effects, not one substance.
entries.definitionCN: 具体的污染物质；marine pollution 指整体输入及其影响，不是某一种物质。

entries.definition: Relating to the sea; it only says where the pollution occurs, not that pollution exists.
entries.definitionCN: 与海有关的；它只说污染发生在哪里，并不表示污染本身。

entries.definition: The presence of a harmful agent in a place or organism; it is narrower than the whole pollution process.
entries.definitionCN: 有害因子出现在某处或某生物体内；它比整个污染过程窄。

entries.definition: Enrichment by nutrients that causes blooms and low oxygen; it is one major form of marine pollution.
entries.definitionCN: 营养盐富集造成藻华与低氧；它是海洋污染的一种主要形式。

entries.definition: A single release of oil; marine pollution covers spills along with chronic inputs from many sources.
entries.definitionCN: 一次石油泄漏；海洋污染还涵盖许多来源的长期输入。

entries.definition: Solid manufactured waste in the sea; it is the visible part of marine pollution, not the whole.
entries.definitionCN: 海中的固体人造垃圾；它是海洋污染可见的一部分，而非全部。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin parts, real treaty terms and real source categories.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁构件、真实条约术语与真实来源类别。

normal.en: Marine means of the sea; pollution means making impure.
normal.cn: marine 是海的；pollution 是使变脏。

normal.en: Most marine pollution starts on land and travels downhill.
normal.cn: 大部分海洋污染从陆地开始，顺流而下。

normal.en: Oil, plastic, nutrients, chemicals and noise are the main families.
normal.cn: 油、塑料、营养盐、化学品与噪声是主要类别。

normal.en: The law defines pollution by harm, not by the pipe it came from.
normal.cn: 法律按危害而非管道来源来定义污染。

normal.en: A dead zone is nutrient pollution seen from space.
normal.cn: 死区是从太空看得见的营养盐污染。

abstract.en: Picture a river carrying a city's hidden waste into a blue bowl.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河把城市隐形的废物带进一只蓝色的大碗。

abstract.en: Picture plastic breaking into pieces smaller than the plankton that eat them.
abstract.cn: 想象塑料裂成比吃它的浮游生物还小的碎片。

abstract.en: Picture a whale trying to sing through a wall of ship noise.
abstract.cn: 想象一头鲸试图穿过一堵船噪声的墙来歌唱。

examples.en: Marine pollution from the river closed the shellfish beds.
examples.cn: 来自河流的海洋污染使贝类养殖区关闭。

examples.en: The treaty targets marine pollution from ships first.
examples.cn: 该条约首先针对来自船舶的海洋污染。

examples.en: Marine pollution knows no border, so states must act together.
examples.cn: 海洋污染不分国界，因此各国必须共同行动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「marine（海洋的）+ pollution（污染）」——进入海洋并造成危害的污染 → 海洋污染

root: 拉丁 mare「海」（更深来源不确定）→ marinus「海的」→ 英语 marine；拉丁 polluere「弄脏、污染」→ pollu- + -tion → pollution。polluere 的内部历史有争议，短语为近代法律与科学搭配。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one harmful input: total contamination, land runoff, oil, plastic, nutrients, chemicals, noise and the legal definition.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一种有害输入展开：总污染、陆源径流、石油、塑料、营养盐、化学品、噪声与法律定义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an oil film on the water outside an estuary, with plastic fragments and foam mixed into the waves.
core.cn: 核心意象：河口外的水面浮着油膜，塑料碎片与泡沫混进浪花。

branches.en: LAND TO SEA: fertilizer and sewage enter by rivers and become nutrient overload offshore.
branches.cn: 从陆到海：化肥与污水经河流进入，在近海变成营养盐过量。

branches.en: VISIBLE AND INVISIBLE: a spill is seen at once, while chemical loads accumulate quietly in tissue.
branches.cn: 可见与不可见：溢油立刻被看见，化学负荷却在组织里悄悄累积。

branches.en: THE DEBRIS: plastic is an input the law must treat as pollution.
branches.cn: 垃圾：塑料是法律必须视为污染的输入。

branches.en: CONDITION TO LAW: a described harm becomes a treaty term with duties attached.
branches.cn: 从状态到法律：被描述的危害变成附有义务的条约术语。

branches.en: THE NOISE: sound itself counts as pollution.
branches.cn: 噪声：声音本身也算作污染。

intro.en: Marine pollution is a two-word Latin-derived phrase; the second word has a verb, a noun and an agent form, so the family is easy to read.
intro.cn: marine pollution 是由两个拉丁来源词构成的短语；第二个词有动词、名词与施事形式，词族容易读出。

latinIntro.en: Mare gives marine; polluere gives pollute, pollution and pollutant. The two Latin lines meet in this modern compound.
latinIntro.cn: mare 提供 marine；polluere 提供 pollute、pollution 与 pollutant。两条拉丁线索在这个近代复合词中相遇。

items.example: Marine life suffers first at the surface.
items.exampleCN: 海洋生命最先在表层受害。

items.example: The factory polluted the bay.
items.exampleCN: 工厂污染了海湾。

items.example: Pollution closed the beach.
items.exampleCN: 污染使海滩关闭。

items.example: The pollutant persists for decades.
items.exampleCN: 这种污染物会存留数十年。

items.meaning: a person or body that pollutes
items.example: The polluter pays under the treaty.
items.exampleCN: 根据条约，污染者付费。

items.example: Polluted sediment harms bottom feeders.
items.exampleCN: 受污染沉积物伤害底栖摄食者。

items.example: Marine pollution crosses national borders.
items.exampleCN: 海洋污染跨越国界。

items.example: Marine-pollution rules cover plastics.
items.exampleCN: 海洋污染规定涵盖塑料。

items.example: Eutrophication follows nutrient pollution.
items.exampleCN: 富营养化紧随营养盐污染。

items.example: Marine debris gathers on the tide line.
items.exampleCN: 海洋垃圾聚集在潮线。

definition_zh: 定性分析；质性分析
definition_en: the analysis of non-numerical material such as interviews, documents or observations in order to identify themes, meanings and patterns
core_image: 长桌上铺开三份访谈稿，彩色便签把相似句子连成几组，墙上贴着一张主题网络图
scene: 三份访谈稿铺在长桌上，彩色便签把相似句子连成几组，墙上贴着一张主题网络图。 Qualitative analysis looks for meaning and pattern rather than for a coefficient.
sceneCN: 这里指对非数值材料的系统分析（第 1 个义项：非数值材料的分析）；句意为定性分析寻找的是意义与模式，而不是系数。图中可辨识物件：访谈稿、彩色便签、主题网络图、长桌、记号笔。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 qualitas「性质」经法语而来，义为「性质；质量」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定性的；性质上的」
由希腊语 analusis「拆解」而来，义为「分析」
由其动词形式而来，义为「分析」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定量的」，与定性成对

senses.title: Analysis of non-numerical material
senses.definition: the examination of words, images, documents or observed actions rather than numerical measurements
senses.definitionCN: 考察词语、图像、文件或观察到的行为，而非数值测量
senses.example: Qualitative analysis looks for meaning and pattern rather than for a coefficient.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析寻找的是意义与模式，而不是系数。
senses.why: Some questions are about what an experience means, and meaning does not arrive as a number.
senses.whyCN: 有些问题问的是经验意味着什么，而意义并不以数字的形式到来。

senses.title: Thematic analysis
senses.definition: the identification and organisation of recurring themes across a body of material
senses.definitionCN: 在一批材料中识别并组织反复出现的主题
senses.example: Thematic qualitative analysis produced three themes about trust and one about time.
senses.exampleCN: 主题式定性分析产生了三个关于信任的主题，以及一个关于时间的主题。
senses.why: A theme is a pattern that recurs across cases, and the analyst must show the cases behind it.
senses.whyCN: 主题是跨个案反复出现的模式，分析者必须展示支撑它的个案。

senses.title: Content analysis
senses.definition: the systematic classification and counting of visible features such as words, frames or images
senses.definitionCN: 对词语、框架或图像等可见特征进行系统分类与计数
senses.example: Content analysis can sit inside qualitative analysis when categories are counted but meaning is also read.
senses.exampleCN: 当类别被计数、意义也被解读时，内容分析可以归在定性分析之内。
senses.why: Counting does not make a study quantitative if the categories themselves were built by reading for meaning.
senses.whyCN: 如果类别本身是通过解读意义建立的，计数并不会让研究变成定量。

senses.title: Coding and grounded theory
senses.definition: the line-by-line labelling of material and the building of categories from the data upward
senses.definitionCN: 逐行标注材料，并从数据向上建立类别
senses.example: Grounded-theory coding is a common route through qualitative analysis.
senses.exampleCN: 扎根理论编码是定性分析中常见的一条路径。
senses.why: The claim is that categories should grow from the material rather than be imposed before reading.
senses.whyCN: 其主张是类别应从材料中生长出来，而不是在阅读前被强加。

senses.title: Case study analysis
senses.definition: the detailed examination of one case or a small set of cases, often combining several kinds of evidence
senses.definitionCN: 对一个或少数个案进行细致考察，常结合多种证据
senses.example: Case study analysis within qualitative analysis traced how a policy changed practice.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析中的个案研究分析追踪了一项政策如何改变实践。
senses.why: A single case cannot be averaged, so the analysis must show mechanism rather than frequency.
senses.whyCN: 单个个案无法被平均，因此分析必须展示机制而不是频率。

senses.title: The contrast with quantitative analysis
senses.definition: the difference between asking how much and asking what kind, how and why
senses.definitionCN: 追问「多少」与追问「何种、如何、为何」之间的区别
senses.example: Qualitative analysis asks what the pattern means, while quantitative analysis asks how large it is.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析追问模式意味着什么，定量分析追问它有多大。
senses.why: The two approaches answer different questions, and a mixed design uses both rather than choosing a winner.
senses.whyCN: 两种取径回答不同问题，混合设计同时使用两者，而不是选一个赢家。

senses.title: Trustworthiness and reflexivity
senses.definition: the criteria of credibility, transferability, dependability and confirmability, supported by an audit trail
senses.definitionCN: 可信性、可迁移性、可靠性与可确认性等标准，并由审计轨迹支撑
senses.example: Trustworthiness in qualitative analysis is established through an audit trail and peer checking.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析中的可信度通过审计轨迹与同伴核查来建立。
senses.why: When the usual statistical criteria do not apply, the work must show its reasoning in public instead.
senses.whyCN: 当通常的统计标准不适用时，研究必须改为公开展示自己的推理。

senses.title: Software-assisted coding
senses.definition: the use of programs to store, label, retrieve and compare coded segments without replacing the analyst's reading
senses.definitionCN: 用程序存储、标注、检索与比较已编码片段，但不取代分析者的阅读
senses.example: Software made the qualitative analysis traceable across four hundred pages of transcripts.
senses.exampleCN: 软件使这项定性分析在四百页逐字稿中仍可追溯。
senses.why: A program can hold the labels and find them again, but it cannot decide what a passage means.
senses.whyCN: 程序可以保存标签并再次找到它们，却不能决定一段文字意味着什么。

intro.en: Qualitative analysis joins qualitative, from Latin qualis, of what kind, to analysis, from Greek analusis, a loosening.
intro.cn: 这个术语把来自拉丁语 qualis「何种性质」的 qualitative，与来自希腊语 analusis「拆解」的 analysis 组合起来。

items.en: Qualis was a question word meaning of what kind, and it supplied the base of quality.
items.cn: qualis 是表示「何种性质」的疑问词，提供 quality 的词基。

items.en: Qualitas named the nature or character of a thing, a translation coinage for a Greek term.
items.cn: qualitas 指事物的本性或特征，是为对应希腊术语而造的译词。

items.en: English used quality for a characteristic and later for excellence; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 quality 指特征，后来指优良程度；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The adjective qualitative marked what concerns kind rather than amount; it spread in nineteenth-century science.
items.cn: 形容词 qualitative 标出关乎种类而非数量，在十九世纪科学中传播。

items.en: Analusis meant a loosening or resolving, from ana- up and luein to loosen.
items.cn: analusis 意为松开或拆解，由 ana-「向上」与 luein「松开」构成。

items.en: Social research joined the two words for the analysis of meaning-bearing material; the phrase is twentieth-century.
items.cn: 社会科学把这两个词组合成对承载意义之材料的分析；这个短语属二十世纪。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like qualitative analysis; the second group names neighbouring approaches to meaning-bearing material.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 qualitative analysis 相近；第二组是与「处理意义材料」意思相邻的取径。

entries.definition: A characteristic, or the degree of excellence.
entries.definitionCN: 指特征，或优良程度。

entries.definition: Concerned with kind or meaning rather than amount.
entries.definitionCN: 指关乎种类或意义而非数量。

entries.definition: The separation of a whole into parts for examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指把整体拆成部分加以考察。

entries.definition: To carry out such an examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指进行这样的考察。

entries.definition: Concerned with amount and measurement; it looks close but its base is quantity.
entries.definitionCN: 指关乎数量与测量；形近但词基是数量。

entries.definition: A method for identifying and organising recurring themes.
entries.definitionCN: 指识别并组织反复主题的方法。

entries.definition: Systematic classification and counting of visible features.
entries.definitionCN: 指对可见特征进行系统分类与计数。

entries.definition: An approach that builds categories upward from the data.
entries.definitionCN: 指从数据向上建立类别的取径。

entries.definition: Long-term study of a group through immersion and field notes.
entries.definitionCN: 指通过长期沉浸与田野笔记研究一个群体。

entries.definition: Detailed examination of one case or a few cases.
entries.definitionCN: 指对一个或少数个案的细致考察。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: Qualis asks of what kind, and analysis loosens a whole into parts, so the phrase means taking meaning-bearing material apart by kind.
normal.cn: qualis 问「何种性质」，「分析」把整体拆成部分，这个短语指按性质拆开承载意义的材料。

normal.en: A theme is a pattern with cases behind it, not a label invented at the end.
normal.cn: 主题是有个案支撑的模式，而不是最后发明出来的标签。

normal.en: Coding is writing on the margin until the margin becomes a map.
normal.cn: 编码是在页边写字，直到页边变成一张地图。

normal.en: Trustworthiness replaces the statistical checklist with an audit trail and peer checking.
normal.cn: 可信度用审计轨迹与同伴核查取代统计清单。

normal.en: Software stores labels and finds them, but it cannot read for meaning.
normal.cn: 软件保存并查找标签，却不能解读意义。

abstract.en: A number answers how much, while a meaning answers what it was like, and the second question cannot be averaged.
abstract.cn: 数字回答多少，意义回答那是什么感觉，而第二个问题无法被平均。

abstract.en: The analyst is a reader with a history, and the audit trail is the history made visible.
abstract.cn: 分析者是带着历史的读者，审计轨迹就是被变得可见的历史。

abstract.en: A theme is a room that many quotations enter, and the analyst must show the door.
abstract.cn: 主题是许多引语进入的房间，分析者必须指出那扇门。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis of the interviews identified three themes about trust.
examples.cn: 对访谈的定性分析识别出三个关于信任的主题。

examples.en: The paper explains how qualitative analysis was coded and checked by a second reader.
examples.cn: 论文说明了定性分析如何编码并由第二位读者核查。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis were combined in a mixed design.
examples.cn: 定性分析与定量分析在混合设计中被结合起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「性质」加「分析」——不数多少，先读每一段在说什么，再把相似的句子连成主题：定性分析。

root: 拉丁 qualis「何种性质」→ qualitas「性质」→ 法语 qualité → 英语 quality → qualitative；希腊 analusis「拆解」← ana-「贯穿」+ luein「松开」→ 英语 analysis；社会科学把两者组合为 qualitative analysis。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the general approach to its methods and standards: non-numerical material, thematic analysis, content analysis, coding and grounded theory, case studies, the contrast with quantitative work, trustworthiness, and software-assisted coding.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从总体取径走向方法与标准：非数值材料、主题分析、内容分析、编码与扎根理论、个案研究、与定量的对照、可信度，以及软件辅助编码。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three transcripts spread on a long table, coloured notes linking similar sentences, and a theme network pinned to the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：长桌上铺开三份访谈稿，彩色便签把相似句子连起来，墙上钉着一张主题网络图。

branches.en: THE KIND OF QUESTION: non-numerical material, and the contrast with asking how much.
branches.cn: 问题的种类：非数值材料，以及与追问多少的对照。

branches.en: THE TWO LABELLING ROUTES: themes built across cases, and visible features classified and counted.
branches.cn: 两条标注路径：跨个案建立主题，以及对可见特征分类计数。

branches.en: THE UPWARD BUILD: codes and categories grown from the material itself.
branches.cn: 向上搭建：从材料本身生长出编码与类别。

branches.en: THE SINGLE CASE: mechanism shown in depth rather than frequency averaged across many.
branches.cn: 单个个案：深入展示机制，而不是在众多案例中平均频率。

branches.en: THE PUBLIC REASONING AND THE TOOL: an audit trail with peer checking, supported by software that stores but does not read.
branches.cn: 公开推理与工具：带同伴核查的审计轨迹，以及只存储不阅读的软件。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin-derived adjective for kind to a Greek-derived noun for loosening.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁来源的「性质」形容词与希腊来源的「拆解」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin qualis and qualitas supply qualitative; Greek ana- and luein supply analysis; -ative and compound syntax are the English joiners.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 qualis 与 qualitas 提供「定性的」一词，希腊语 ana- 与 luein 提供「分析」，形容词词尾与复合句法是英语的连接件。

items.example: It supplies the base of quality.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 quality 的词基。

items.example: It becomes English quality.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语 quality。

items.example: It forms qualitative.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 qualitative。

items.example: It marks the first half of the phrase.
items.exampleCN: 它标出短语的前半。

items.example: It marks taking a whole apart.
items.exampleCN: 它标出把整体拆开。

items.example: It supplies the dissolving image.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「拆解」的意象。

items.structure: Greek noun from ana- plus luein
items.example: It becomes English analysis.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语 analysis。

items.meaning: separation of a whole into parts
items.example: The second half names the operation.
items.exampleCN: 后半命名这一操作。

items.meaning: a label attached to a segment
items.example: Coding is the basic move of the method.
items.exampleCN: 编码是这种方法的基本动作。

items.example: A theme is the pattern codes build toward.
items.exampleCN: 主题是编码向上搭成的模式。

latinEntries.structure: analysis, analysis (f., third declension, from Greek analusis)
thema, thematis (n., third declension, from Greek thema)
