由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定性的；性质上的」
由希腊语 analusis「拆解」而来，义为「分析」
由其动词形式而来，义为「分析」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「定量的」，与定性成对

definition_zh: 记忆；把信息反复记入脑中的过程，也常指死记硬背
definition_en: the process of committing information to memory, often by repeated practice or rote learning
core_image: 一个人把卡片一张张翻过，直到不看也能复述
scene: 考前一周，学生每天抄写同一列年代，直到合上书也能按顺序说出。 For a week before the exam the student writes the same list of dates until she can recite it with the book closed, a routine of pure memorization.
sceneCN: 这里 memorization 指「把信息反复记入脑中的过程」（第 1 个义项：靠重复把内容固定下来）；句意为学生一周内每天抄写同一列年代，直到合上书也能按顺序背出。图中可辨识物件：卡片、年代列表、合上的书、计时器。

pos.zh: 记忆；背诵；死记硬背（不可数）

senses.title: The process of committing to memory
senses.titleCN: 把信息记入脑中的过程
senses.definition: the process of fixing information in the mind through study or repetition
senses.definitionCN: 通过学习或重复把信息固定在心中的过程
senses.example: She writes the dates until she can recite them with the book closed.
senses.exampleCN: 她把年代写到合上书也能背出的程度。
senses.why: the -ation suffix names an action, so memorization is the work of putting something in, not the thing stored.
senses.whyCN: -ation 后缀命名一个动作，因此 memorization 是「放进去」的工作，而非被存放的东西。

senses.title: The state of having been memorized
senses.definition: the condition of being held in memory as a result of such work
senses.definitionCN: 因这番工夫而被保存在记忆中的状态
senses.example: The dates were kept in memorization for years.
senses.exampleCN: 这些年代被记住并保留了很多年。
senses.why: an action noun can slide into its result; what has been done stays done, and the word names that staying.
senses.whyCN: 动作名词可以滑向结果；做过的事保持完成状态，而这个词命名这种保持。

senses.title: Rote learning without understanding
senses.definition: learning by repetition alone, often with the implication that meaning is neglected
senses.definitionCN: 仅靠重复的学习，常暗示忽略了意义
senses.example: The course rewards memorization over explanation.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课奖励背诵多于解释。
senses.why: the same process becomes a criticism when it is separated from understanding; the word carries that judgement in school talk.
senses.whyCN: 同一种过程一旦与理解分离就变成批评；在学校话语里，这个词带着这种评判。

senses.title: Material that has been memorized
senses.definition: the text, list or lines one has learned by heart
senses.definitionCN: 已经熟记的文本、清单或台词
senses.example: The actor ran through his memorization before the scene.
senses.exampleCN: 演员在开场前把背下的台词过了一遍。
senses.why: metonymy turns the act into the thing acted on, as when a recitation is called a memorization.
senses.whyCN: 转喻把动作变成被作用之物，于是背下来的内容也被称作 memorization。

senses.title: A classroom exercise
senses.definition: a school task in which pupils learn facts or texts by heart
senses.definitionCN: 要求学生熟记事实或文本的课堂任务
senses.example: The weekly memorization test covers twenty words.
senses.exampleCN: 每周的记忆测验覆盖二十个单词。
senses.why: schools need countable exercises, so the general process becomes an item on the timetable.
senses.whyCN: 学校需要可计数的练习，于是一般过程变成课表上的一个项目。

senses.title: Encoding and consolidation in psychology
senses.titleCN: 心理学中的编码与巩固
senses.definition: the laboratory process by which material is encoded and then stabilized in long-term memory
senses.definitionCN: 材料被编码并在长时记忆中稳定下来的实验过程
senses.example: Sleep improves the memorization of new vocabulary.
senses.exampleCN: 睡眠有助于新词汇的记忆巩固。
senses.why: when psychologists look inside the process, repetition splits into encoding and consolidation, and this word covers both stages.
senses.whyCN: 心理学家看进过程内部后，重复被分成编码与巩固，而这个词覆盖两个阶段。

senses.title: Learning lines for performance
senses.definition: the actor's or musician's work of fixing lines, cues or scores in memory
senses.definitionCN: 演员或乐手把台词、提示或乐谱记牢的工作
senses.example: Her memorization of the monologue took three days.
senses.exampleCN: 她背下那段独白用了三天。
senses.why: performance cannot pause for a script, so the same process becomes a professional skill with its own practice routines.
senses.whyCN: 演出不能为剧本暂停，因此同一种过程成为有专门练法的职业技能。

senses.title: Recitation of sacred or traditional texts
senses.titleCN: 宗教或传统经典的记诵
senses.definition: the disciplined learning by heart of scriptures, poems or oral tradition
senses.definitionCN: 对经文、诗篇或口传传统的有纪律的熟记
senses.example: Monks begin memorization of the sutras at an early age.
senses.exampleCN: 僧侣很早就开始记诵经文。
senses.why: where a text must survive without copying, memory is the medium, and memorization is the technology.
senses.whyCN: 当文本必须在不靠复制的情况下流传，记忆就是媒介，而记诵就是那项技术。

intro.en: Memorization joins memorize with -ation; memorize itself comes from memory, from Latin memoria. The word is a modern English formation, not a classical Latin noun. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: memorization 由 memorize 加 -ation 构成；memorize 又来自 memory，源自拉丁 memoria。这是现代英语的构造，并非古典拉丁名词。年代为约数。

items.en: Memoria 'memory' comes from memor 'mindful'; it supplied the noun from which the English verb was later built.
items.cn: memoria「记忆」源自 memor「记得的」，为后来英语动词提供名词基础。

items.en: English memory appeared in the thirteenth century; the verb memorize 'commit to memory' is recorded from the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 英语 memory 在 13 世纪出现；动词 memorize「记入记忆」在 16 世纪有记录。

items.en: The suffix -ation, from Latin -atio, names an action or its result; adding it to memorize produced memorization in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 后缀 -ation 源自拉丁 -atio，命名动作或结果；加在 memorize 上，于 19 世纪构成 memorization。

items.en: British English also writes memorisation with -isa-, following the same pattern as organise; both forms are current.
items.cn: 英式英语也写作 memorisation，用 -isa-，与 organise 的拼法一致；两种形式都在使用。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the first recorded use of memorization is usually placed in the nineteenth century, but the exact year is not agreed, and the boundary with memorisation is purely orthographic.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：memorization 的最早书证通常定在 19 世纪，但确切年份没有定论；它与 memorisation 的差别纯属拼写。

note.en: Group one holds look-alike forms, including a technical term from computing that is not the same word; group two holds methods and products of learning by heart.
note.cn: 第一组是外形相近的形式，其中含一个并非同词的计算机术语；第二组是熟记的方法与产物。

entries.definition: The same word spelled with -isa-; the difference is orthographic only.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词的英式拼写，用 -isa-；差别只在拼写。

entries.definition: A programming technique that caches function results; it is coined from memo, not from memory, and has nothing to do with human recall.
entries.definitionCN: 一种缓存函数结果的编程技术；由 memo 而非 memory 造出，与人的回忆无关。

entries.definition: To commit something to memory; memorization is the noun naming that activity.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物记入记忆；memorization 是命名该活动的名词。

entries.definition: The faculty or content of remembering; memorization names the effort that fills it.
entries.definitionCN: 记忆的能力或内容；memorization 命名填满它的那番努力。

entries.definition: Learning by repetition without attention to meaning; memorization can be rote, but need not be.
entries.definitionCN: 不看意义、只靠重复的学习；memorization 可以是死记，但不必然如此。

entries.definition: Doing or saying the same thing again; it is the engine that makes memorization work.
entries.definitionCN: 重复做或说同一件事；是让记忆生效的引擎。

entries.definition: Saying aloud what has been learned by heart; it displays memorization rather than producing it.
entries.definitionCN: 出声说出背下的内容；展示记忆，而非产生记忆。

entries.definition: How much remains available after learning; it is the measure of successful memorization.
entries.definitionCN: 学习后还能保留多少；是记忆成功与否的度量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: memory + -ize + -ation: the store, the act of filling it, and the name of that act.
normal.cn: memory + -ize + -ation：库房、装填的动作，以及这一动作的名称。

normal.en: The family runs memorize, memorizer, memory, memorable and memorization.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 memorize、memorizer、memory、memorable 与 memorization。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the use: rote memorization, memorization task, memorization technique.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：死记硬背、记忆任务、记忆技巧。

normal.en: Memorization is the process; memory is the store; recall is the retrieval.
normal.cn: memorization 是过程，memory 是库房，recall 是取出。

normal.en: Do not confuse memorization with memoization: the computing term comes from memo, not memory.
normal.cn: 不要把 memorization 与 memoization 混淆：计算机术语来自 memo，而非 memory。

abstract.en: Picture a hand copying the same line until the line lives in the hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手反复抄同一行，直到那一行住进手里。

abstract.en: Picture a door closing on a full shelf and opening only when called.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门在一排满架前关上，只在被呼唤时打开。

abstract.en: Picture a monk reciting in the dark because the book is inside him.
abstract.cn: 想象僧人在黑暗中诵经，因为书就在他体内。

examples.en: The exam rewards memorization more than analysis.
examples.cn: 这场考试奖励背诵多于分析。

examples.en: Daily memorization of ten words beats one long session.
examples.cn: 每天记十个词胜过一次性长时间苦背。

examples.en: Sleep supports the consolidation that memorization requires.
examples.cn: 睡眠支持记忆所需要的巩固过程。

dict_mnemonic.text: memory（记忆）+ ization（过程）——把东西一遍遍放进记忆的过程 → 记忆、背诵

root: memory（拉丁 memoria）+ -ize（使……化）+ -ation（过程）；19 世纪英语构造，指把信息反复记入脑中的过程。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses describe the same work from different angles: the act, its result, rote method, learned material, classroom task, laboratory encoding, stage work and sacred recitation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从不同角度描述同一番工夫：动作、结果、死记方法、背下的材料、课堂任务、实验编码、舞台功夫，以及经文记诵。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same line written again and again until it can be said without the page.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一行字被反复抄写，直到不看纸也能说出。

branches.en: ACT AND RESULT: the work of putting in, then the state of being held.
branches.cn: 动作与结果：先放入的工夫，再是被保存的状态。

branches.en: WITHOUT MEANING: repetition alone turns the method into a criticism.
branches.cn: 不求意义：只剩重复时，方法就成了批评对象。

branches.en: MATERIAL AND STAGE: what is held can be a list for a test or lines for a scene.
branches.cn: 材料与舞台：记住的可以是测验清单，也可以是场景台词。

branches.en: INSTITUTION AND LAB: the same act becomes a timetable item and an encoding stage.
branches.cn: 建制与实验：同一动作既成为课表项目，也成为编码阶段。

branches.en: SACRED USE: where no copy exists, memory is the only medium.
branches.cn: 神圣用法：在没有副本的地方，记忆是唯一媒介。

intro.en: Memorization stacks three pieces: the Latin stem memor, the verb suffix -ize and the noun suffix -ation.
intro.cn: memorization 叠了三层：拉丁词干 memor、动词后缀 -ize、名词后缀 -ation。

latinIntro.en: Latin memor 'mindful' yields memoria; English memory, memorize and memorization continue the line, while the computing term memoization comes from memo instead.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 memor「记得的」生成 memoria；英语 memory、memorize、memorization 延续这条线，而计算机术语 memoization 来自 memo。

items.example: Memor is the base of the whole family.
items.exampleCN: memor 是整个词族的基础。

items.meaning: to make, to subject to a process
items.example: Memory plus -ize gives the verb memorize.
items.exampleCN: memory 加 -ize 构成动词 memorize。

items.meaning: the act or result of a process
items.example: Memorize plus -ation names the activity.
items.exampleCN: memorize 加 -ation 命名这项活动。

items.meaning: the act of committing to memory
items.meaningCN: 把信息记入记忆的行为
items.example: Memorization without meaning fades fast.
items.exampleCN: 没有意义的背诵忘得很快。

items.example: She memorized the dates in a week.
items.exampleCN: 她一周内背下了这些年代。

items.example: A good memorizer still needs a schedule.
items.exampleCN: 擅长背诵的人仍然需要计划。

items.example: Memory supplies the material.
items.exampleCN: 记忆提供材料。

items.example: A memorable fact is easier to keep.
items.exampleCN: 难忘的事实更容易保留。

items.example: The memorized lines sounded flat.
items.exampleCN: 背下的台词听起来很平。

items.example: The day is one of commemoration, not study.
items.exampleCN: 这一天是纪念，不是学习。

definition_zh: 有毒的；毒性的；由毒物引起的；比喻有害的
definition_en: poisonous to living organisms, or harmful in a way compared to poison
core_image: 水边一只死鸟旁，黑色油泥泛着彩光，沾在手套上久久不散
scene: 志愿者在水边捡起一只死鸟，手套上沾着发亮的黑色油泥。 The spill left a toxic residue along the shoreline.
sceneCN: 这里 toxic 指「对生物有毒的、能造成伤害的」（第 1 个义项：物质对活体生物具有毒性）；句意为泄漏在岸线上留下一层有毒残留物。图中可辨识物件：死鸟、黑色油泥、手套、岸线。

senses.title: Poisonous to living organisms
senses.definition: capable of harming or killing an organism by chemical action
senses.definitionCN: 能通过化学作用伤害或杀死生物的
senses.example: The spill left a toxic residue along the shoreline.
senses.exampleCN: 泄漏在岸线上留下一层有毒残留物。
senses.why: The word began as the adjective of Greek toxikon, the poison smeared on arrows, so its core image is a substance that kills at a distance.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是希腊 toxikon 的形容词，指涂在箭上的毒，因此核心意象是「能在远处致死的物质」。

senses.title: Caused by poison, as a medical condition
senses.definition: describing an illness, dose or effect produced by a poison or drug
senses.definitionCN: 描述由毒物或药物引起的疾病、剂量或效应
senses.example: The patient showed a toxic reaction to the drug.
senses.exampleCN: 病人对该药出现了毒性反应。
senses.why: Medicine needed an adjective for harm caused by a substance, as distinct from harm caused by infection or injury.
senses.whyCN: 医学需要一个形容词来指「由物质造成的伤害」，以区别于感染或外伤造成的伤害。

senses.title: Chemically hazardous in industry
senses.definition: describing waste, gas or material that must be handled under special safety rules
senses.definitionCN: 描述必须在专门安全规则下处理的废物、气体或材料
senses.example: Toxic waste must be stored away from the water table.
senses.exampleCN: 有毒废物必须远离地下水位存放。
senses.why: Regulation turned the adjective into a label that triggers permits, protective gear and disposal rules.
senses.whyCN: 监管把这个形容词变成一个标签，一贴上就触发许可、防护装备与处置规则。

senses.title: Produced by a living organism
senses.definition: describing a poison made by a plant, animal or microbe, as in a toxic secretion
senses.definitionCN: 描述由植物、动物或微生物制造的毒物，如毒性分泌物
senses.example: The frog's skin carries a toxic secretion.
senses.exampleCN: 这只蛙的皮肤带有毒性分泌物。
senses.why: Biology separates what is made by life from what is made in a factory, though both are called toxic.
senses.whyCN: 生物学要区分「生命制造的」与「工厂制造的」，尽管两者都叫 toxic。

senses.title: Harmful to a person's mind or relationships
senses.titleCN: 对人的心理或关系有害的
senses.definition: describing behaviour, a relationship or an atmosphere that damages people psychologically
senses.definitionCN: 描述在心理上伤害人的行为、关系或氛围
senses.example: She left a toxic working environment.
senses.exampleCN: 她离开了一个有害的工作环境。
senses.why: The metaphor works because the harm is slow, cumulative and hard to see, like exposure to a poison.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻成立，是因为伤害缓慢、累积且难以看见，像接触毒物一样。

senses.title: Worthless and dangerous financial assets
senses.definition: describing loans or securities whose value has collapsed and which threaten the holder
senses.definitionCN: 描述价值已崩塌、并危及持有者的贷款或证券
senses.example: The bank was left holding toxic assets.
senses.exampleCN: 这家银行最后手里握着有毒资产。
senses.why: Finance borrowed the word because the asset poisons the balance sheet it sits on.
senses.whyCN: 金融界借用这个词，因为这类资产会毒害它所在的资产负债表。

senses.title: Slang: extremely bad or unpleasant
senses.titleCN: 口语：极糟的、令人难受的
senses.definition: an informal use meaning very bad, offensive or unbearable
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法，指很糟、令人反感或难以忍受
senses.example: The traffic was toxic all afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 整个下午的交通都糟透了。
senses.why: Slang strips the word down to pure intensity, keeping the sense of harm without any chemistry.
senses.whyCN: 口语把这个词剥离成纯粹的强度，只留「有害」的感觉，不带任何化学含义。

senses.title: Listed as toxic by regulation
senses.definition: formally classified as a hazardous substance with a defined threshold and reporting duty
senses.definitionCN: 被正式归为危险物质，附有明确阈值与申报义务
senses.example: The solvent is toxic under the clean-air rules.
senses.exampleCN: 这种溶剂在清洁空气法规下被列为有毒。
senses.why: A legal label is a separate sense because the classification does not depend on how the substance behaves in each case.
senses.whyCN: 法律标签之所以是独立义项，是因为归类并不取决于该物质在每种情形下的实际表现。

senses.title: Abstract: corrosive to a group or culture
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：对群体或文化起腐蚀作用
senses.definition: describing norms, speech or incentives that slowly damage trust and cooperation
senses.definitionCN: 描述缓慢损害信任与合作的规范、言论或激励机制
senses.example: The report called the incentives toxic for new staff.
senses.exampleCN: 报告称这些激励机制对新员工有害。
senses.why: The final extension keeps the medical shape: a small repeated exposure produces a systemic illness.
senses.whyCN: 最后的延伸保留了医学形态：少量而反复的接触会造成全身性的病症。

intro.en: Toxic came to English through Latin from Greek, where the original poison was the one put on arrows. The figurative senses are modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: toxic 经拉丁语从希腊语进入英语，原本的毒是涂在箭上的那种。比喻义是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Toxon meant 'bow'. Its own origin is uncertain; it is often treated as a borrowing from a non-Greek language, so any older form offered for it is a hypothesis rather than a proved source.
items.cn: toxon 意为「弓」。它本身的来源不确定；常被看作借自某种非希腊语，因此凡为它给出的更早形式都是假说，而非已证实的来源。

items.en: Toxikon (pharmakon) meant 'arrow poison', literally the thing of the bow; the adjective toxikos described what belonged to the bow or to its poison.
items.cn: toxikon（pharmakon）意为「箭毒」，字面是「属于弓的东西」；形容词 toxikos 描述属于弓或其毒物者。

items.en: Latin toxicum meant 'poison', and toxicus was its adjective; medieval and early modern writers used both for venoms and drugs.
items.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 意为「毒」，toxicus 是其形容词；中世纪与近代早期作者用两者兼指毒液与药物。

items.en: English toxic appears in the seventeenth century as a learned adjective meaning 'poisonous', alongside the noun toxicum.
items.cn: 英语 toxic 在十七世纪作为学术形容词出现，意为「有毒的」，同时还有名词 toxicum。

items.en: Toxicology and industrial hygiene made toxic a standard term for chemical harm, and twentieth-century law turned it into a regulatory category.
items.cn: 毒理学与工业卫生使 toxic 成为化学危害的标准术语，二十世纪的法律又把它变成监管类别。

items.en: Source uncertain (origin of toxon, first date of the figurative senses): the bow word may be a foreign borrowing whose source is unknown, and no single earliest citation is fixed for the relational or slang senses, so their dates are approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（toxon 的来源、比喻义的首见年代）：「弓」这个词可能是外来借词，而借自何处不明；关系义与口语义也没有公认的最早书证，年代只能约计。

note.en: Group one holds words from the same poison stock that differ in part of speech or in sense; group two holds adjectives of harm, each with its own route of injury.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「毒」词干、词性或含义不同的词；第二组是表示「有害」的形容词，各自的伤害路径不同。

entries.definition: A poison made by a living organism, such as a bacterial toxin; toxic is the adjective describing such a substance or its effect.
entries.definitionCN: 由活生物制造的毒物，如细菌毒素；toxic 是描述这种物质或其效应的形容词。

entries.definition: The study of poisons and their effects; it is a discipline name, not a description of a substance.
entries.definitionCN: 研究毒物及其效应的学科；它是学科名称，而非物质描述。

entries.definition: To make drunk or wildly excited, from the same toxicum; the modern sense has left poison behind.
entries.definitionCN: 使醉或使极度兴奋，同出 toxicum；现代义已离开了「毒」的意思。

entries.definition: A condition in which toxins are present in the blood; it names the medical state rather than the property.
entries.definitionCN: 毒素存在于血液中的状况；它命名的是医学状态，而非性质。

entries.definition: Able to harm when eaten, drunk or touched; it is the everyday word, while toxic is the technical and figurative one.
entries.definitionCN: 吃下、喝下或接触时能造成伤害；它是日常词，而 toxic 更技术化、也更多比喻用法。

entries.tag: injected by a bite or sting
entries.definition: Able to inject poison through a bite or sting; a venomous animal is not simply toxic, because the delivery matters.
entries.definitionCN: 能通过咬或蜇注入毒液；venomous 的动物不能简单说成 toxic，因为「如何送入」很关键。

entries.definition: Harmful, especially to health or to the senses, as of fumes; it stresses the unpleasant exposure rather than the chemistry.
entries.definitionCN: 有害的，尤指对健康或感官，如烟气；它强调难受的接触，而非化学性质。

entries.definition: Extremely infectious or severe, used of pathogens and, figuratively, of hostility; it is about spreading power, not poison.
entries.definitionCN: 传染性极强或极严重的，用于病原体，也比喻敌意；它讲的是传播力，而非毒性。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The root is Greek toxon 'bow': the first toxic thing was arrow poison.
normal.cn: 词根是希腊 toxon「弓」：最早的「有毒之物」是箭毒。

normal.en: The family runs toxin, toxicity, toxicology, toxicologist and detoxify.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 toxin、toxicity、toxicology、toxicologist 与 detoxify。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: toxic waste, toxic substance, toxic effect, highly toxic.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：有毒废物、有毒物质、毒性效应、剧毒的。

normal.en: Toxic is the adjective; toxin is the substance; toxicity is the degree.
normal.cn: toxic 是形容词；toxin 是物质；toxicity 是程度。

normal.en: Venomous means injected by bite or sting, which is narrower than toxic.
normal.cn: venomous 指经咬或蜇注入，比 toxic 窄。

abstract.en: Picture a drop of poison that takes hours to show its work.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴毒物要过几个小时才显出作用。

abstract.en: Picture a room where every conversation leaves you a little more tired.
abstract.cn: 想象一间屋子，每次谈话都让你更疲惫一点。

abstract.en: Picture a loan on a ledger that quietly poisons every page around it.
abstract.cn: 想象账本上的一笔贷款，悄悄毒害周围每一页。

examples.en: The compound is toxic to fish at very low concentrations.
examples.cn: 这种化合物在极低浓度下就对鱼类有毒。

examples.en: Workers handling toxic waste wear sealed suits.
examples.cn: 处理有毒废物的工人穿着密封防护服。

examples.en: The label toxic is also used for relationships and cultures.
examples.cn: toxic 这个标签也被用于关系和职场文化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「tox（弓/箭）+ ic」——涂在箭上的那种东西 → 有毒的

root: 拉丁 toxicus < toxicum「毒」< 希腊 toxikon（pharmakon）「箭毒」< toxon「弓」；toxon 的来源不确定，可能借自非希腊语。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one poison: the substance, the dose, the body, the damage, the label, and then relationships, money, slang and culture borrow the same shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一种毒展开：物质、剂量、身体、损害、标签，随后关系、金钱、口语与文化都借用了同一形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arrow poison, a substance that kills from a distance.
core.cn: 核心意象：箭毒，一种能在远处致死的物质。

branches.en: BODY: the property of poison and the medical reaction are the same harm seen from outside and inside.
branches.cn: 身体：毒的性质与医学反应，是同一伤害从外面与里面看到的样子。

branches.en: LABEL: industrial handling and legal classification both turn toxicity into a rule.
branches.cn: 标签：工业处置与法律归类都把毒性变成一条规则。

branches.en: LIFE-MADE: a secretion from a plant or animal is poison with a maker.
branches.cn: 生物制造：植物或动物的分泌物，是有制造者的毒。

branches.en: SOCIAL AND FINANCIAL: a relationship and a bad loan both poison what contains them.
branches.cn: 社会与金融：一段关系与一笔坏账，都会毒害容纳它们的东西。

branches.en: INTENSITY: slang keeps only the harm, and culture keeps the slow cumulative exposure.
branches.cn: 强度：口语只留下「有害」，文化义保留「缓慢累积的接触」。

intro.en: Toxic is a Greek-derived adjective with a root that reaches back to the bow and a suffix that makes a quality.
intro.cn: toxic 是希腊来源形容词，词根可追到「弓」，后缀则构成性质形容词。

latinIntro.en: Latin toxicum gives toxic, toxin, toxicity, toxicology and intoxicate; Greek toxon 'bow' is the root behind all of them.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 toxicum 衍生 toxic、toxin、toxicity、toxicology 与 intoxicate；希腊 toxon「弓」是它们共同的根。

items.example: The bow word gave its name to arrow poison.
items.exampleCN: 「弓」这个词把名字给了箭毒。

items.structure: toxikon (Greek adjective/noun, 'of the bow; arrow poison')
items.example: Toxikon named the poison on the arrowhead.
items.exampleCN: toxikon 指涂在箭头上的毒。

items.example: The adjective entered English as toxic.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词以 toxic 进入英语。

items.example: The suffix makes a quality adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成性质形容词。

items.example: The gas was toxic in the tunnel.
items.exampleCN: 隧道里的气体有毒。

items.meaning: a poison, especially from an organism
items.example: The bacterium released a toxin.
items.exampleCN: 细菌释放出一种毒素。

items.example: They measured the toxicity of the sample.
items.exampleCN: 他们测定了样本的毒性。

items.example: Toxicology screened the water.
items.exampleCN: 毒理学对水做了筛查。

items.example: The liver detoxifies the blood.
items.exampleCN: 肝脏为血液解毒。

items.example: The drink intoxicated him quickly.
items.exampleCN: 这酒很快让他醉了。

definition_zh: 火山作用；火山活动；火山现象；行星火山作用
definition_en: the set of processes by which magma, gases and other fluids rise from a planet's interior to its surface, and the phenomena that result
core_image: 地下的熔融物质沿裂隙上涌，在地表堆出锥丘、铺开岩流，同时把气体送入大气
scene: 裂谷边缘，勘察队刚布好仪器，地面正在缓慢抬升。 Along the rift, volcanism keeps building new crust even between eruptions.
sceneCN: 这里 volcanism 是「火山作用」（第 1 个义项：岩浆与气体由星球内部上升到地表的过程及其产物）；句意为裂谷一带的火山作用在两次喷发之间仍在不断生成新的地壳。

pos.zh: 火山作用；火山活动；火山现象的总称

forms.label: 形容词（火山的；火山作用的）

derivatives.zh: 火山的；火山作用的；火山似的
以火山方式；由火山作用
冰火山作用（喷出的是水、氨等挥发性物质）

senses.title: The process itself
senses.definition: the rise of magma and associated fluids from the interior to the surface, together with the phenomena it produces
senses.definitionCN: 岩浆及相关流体由内部上升到地表的过程，连同它所造成的现象
senses.example: Along the rift, volcanism keeps building new crust even between eruptions.
senses.exampleCN: 裂谷一带的火山作用在两次喷发之间仍在不断生成新的地壳。
senses.why: volcanism adds -ism to volcano, and that suffix turns a thing into a process, so the word names activity rather than a mountain.
senses.whyCN: volcanism 在 volcano 之后加 -ism，这个后缀把事物变成过程，因此此词指活动而非山体。

senses.title: The global pattern of activity
senses.titleCN: 全球火山作用的分布格局
senses.definition: the worldwide distribution of volcanic activity, concentrated at plate boundaries, rifts and hot spots
senses.definitionCN: 全球火山活动的分布，集中于板块边界、裂谷与热点
senses.example: Global volcanism clusters along the rim of the Pacific.
senses.exampleCN: 全球火山作用集中分布在太平洋边缘。
senses.why: once the process was mapped, the same noun could name a pattern on a world map rather than a single vent.
senses.whyCN: 当这个过程被绘制成图之后，同一个名词便能指世界地图上的格局，而不只是一个喷口。

senses.title: Volcanic activity on other worlds
senses.definition: volcanic activity on any solid body, driven by internal heat from tidal flexing, decay or residual accretion
senses.definitionCN: 任何固态天体上的火山活动，由潮汐揉搓、放射性衰变或残余吸积的内热驱动
senses.example: On Io, volcanism renews the surface faster than impacts can mark it.
senses.exampleCN: 在木卫一上，火山作用更新表面的速度快过撞击留下痕迹的速度。
senses.why: the process does not depend on Earth's particular tectonics, so planetary science kept the noun and changed only the setting.
senses.whyCN: 这一过程并不依赖地球特有的构造机制，因此行星科学保留了这个名词，只更换了场景。

senses.title: Effusive versus explosive style
senses.titleCN: 溢流式与爆炸式喷发方式
senses.definition: the manner in which material leaves a vent, from quiet lava flows to violent fragmentation and tall columns
senses.definitionCN: 物质离开喷口的方式，从安静的岩流到猛烈的碎化与高耸灰柱
senses.example: Effusive volcanism builds broad shields instead of steep cones.
senses.exampleCN: 溢流式火山作用堆出宽阔的盾状体，而不是陡峭的锥体。
senses.why: the noun covers the whole process, so a style adjective can pick out one mode of that process without changing the noun.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词涵盖整个过程，因此加一个方式形容词就能挑出其中一种模式，而名词本身不变。

senses.title: Ancient volcanism in the rock record
senses.titleCN: 岩石记录中的古老火山作用
senses.definition: volcanic activity of the geological past, read from lava flows, ash layers and intrusive bodies
senses.definitionCN: 地质历史时期的火山活动，从岩流、火山灰层与侵入体读出
senses.example: Ancient volcanism left thick basalt flows across the basin.
senses.exampleCN: 古老的火山作用在整个盆地留下厚厚的玄武岩流。
senses.why: a process can be ancient, so the same noun describes activity known only from its products, with no live vent left.
senses.whyCN: 过程可以是古老的，因此同一个名词能描述仅由产物得知、已无活动喷口的活动。

senses.title: Cryovolcanism
senses.definition: eruption of water, ammonia or other volatiles instead of molten rock, chiefly on icy bodies
senses.definitionCN: 喷出的是水、氨或其他挥发性物质而非熔岩，主要见于冰质天体
senses.example: Cryovolcanism on icy moons releases water through cracks in the shell.
senses.exampleCN: 冰质卫星上的冰火山作用通过冰壳裂缝释放水。
senses.why: the prefix cryo- marks the fluid as cold, while volcanism supplies the whole rising-and-erupting frame.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 cryo- 标明流体是冷的，而 volcanism 提供整套上涌并喷出的框架。

senses.title: Volcanism and climate
senses.definition: the effect of volcanic gases and particles on atmospheric temperature, chemistry and circulation
senses.definitionCN: 火山气体与颗粒对大气温度、化学成分与环流的影响
senses.example: Large-scale volcanism can cool the climate for several years.
senses.exampleCN: 大规模的火山作用能使气候变冷数年。
senses.why: because the word names a process with outputs, it easily takes a second noun naming what those outputs act upon.
senses.whyCN: 因为此词指带产物的过程，它很容易再接一个名词，说明这些产物作用于什么。

senses.title: The object of a science
senses.definition: the process as observed, measured and modelled by volcanologists
senses.definitionCN: 被火山学家观测、测量与建模的过程
senses.example: Researchers treat volcanism as a process to be measured, not merely described.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者把火山作用视为需要测量的过程，而不只是加以描述。
senses.why: a named process can become a research object, so the noun also serves as the subject matter of a discipline.
senses.whyCN: 被命名的过程可以成为研究对象，因此这个名词也充当一门学科的主题。

intro.en: Volcanism is an English coinage of the nineteenth century: volcano plus the suffix -ism, which reached English through French and Latin from Greek -ismos. It names the process rather than the mountain.
intro.cn: volcanism 是十九世纪英语新构的词：volcano 加后缀 -ism，而 -ism 经法语与拉丁语来自希腊语 -ismos。它指过程，而非山体。

items.en: Volcanus was the Roman god of fire and the forge, and his name passed to a smoking island north of Sicily.
items.cn: Volcanus 是罗马的火与锻造之神，他的名字传给了西西里以北一座冒烟的岛。

items.en: Italian vulcano gave English volcano, so the stem already meant a burning mountain before any suffix was added.
items.cn: 意大利语 vulcano 给了英语 volcano，因此在加任何后缀之前，这个词干已指燃烧的山。

items.en: -ismos was a Greek suffix forming nouns of action, practice or system; Latin -ismus and French -isme carried it into English.
items.cn: -ismos 是希腊语后缀，构成表示动作、实践或体系的名词；拉丁 -ismus 与法语 -isme 把它带入英语。

items.en: English formed volcanism to name the process as a subject of study, at a time when geology was separating into specialised fields.
items.cn: 英语构造出 volcanism，把这一过程作为研究对象命名，当时地质学正分化为若干专门领域。

items.en: Twentieth-century planetary science widened volcanism to any solid world and coined cryovolcanism for icy bodies.
items.cn: 二十世纪的行星科学把 volcanism 扩展到任何固态天体，并为冰质天体造出 cryovolcanism。

items.en: The older spelling vulcanism persists in some texts and carried alchemical overtones; the deeper origin of Volcanus is uncertain and possibly Etruscan.
items.cn: 较旧的拼法 vulcanism 仍见于部分文本，并带炼金术色彩；Volcanus 的更深来源不确定，可能与伊特鲁里亚语有关。

note.en: Group one holds forms built on the same volcano stem, including the old spelling; group two holds terms for the activity or its products.
note.cn: 第一组是由同一个 volcano 词干构成的形式，包括旧拼法；第二组是表示这种活动或其产物的词。

entries.definition: The mountain or vent structure itself; volcanism is what that structure does over time.
entries.definitionCN: 山体或喷口构造本身；volcanism 是这种构造在时间中的活动。

entries.definition: Of or produced by a volcano; it describes material or origin, while volcanism names the whole process.
entries.definitionCN: 火山的或火山造成的；描述材料或来源，而 volcanism 指整个过程。

entries.definition: An older variant spelling of volcanism, also used in alchemical writing for the action of fire; not a separate process.
entries.definitionCN: volcanism 的较旧异体拼写，也用于炼金术文献指火的作用；并非另一种过程。

entries.definition: The science that studies volcanism and its products; the discipline is named after the process, not the reverse.
entries.definitionCN: 研究火山作用及其产物的学科；学科名由过程名而来，而非相反。

entries.definition: The generation and movement of magma anywhere in a planet, including bodies that never reach the surface; volcanism is its surface expression.
entries.definitionCN: 行星内部岩浆的生成与运移，包括从未到达地表的部分；volcanism 是它的地表表现。

entries.definition: A single act of material bursting out; volcanism is the long-running process that produces many such events.
entries.definitionCN: 物质冲出的一次动作；volcanism 是产生许多此类事件的长过程。

entries.definition: Activity involving molten rock and its solidification; it stresses the rock produced rather than the surface phenomena.
entries.definitionCN: 涉及熔融岩石及其固结的活动；强调生成的岩石，而非地表现象。

entries.definition: Surface evidence of internal heat such as hot springs and steam; it can occur with little or no magma involved.
entries.definitionCN: 内部热量的地表表现，如温泉与蒸汽；可以在很少或没有岩浆参与时发生。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: volcano plus -ism: the mountain name turned into the name of a process.
normal.cn: volcano 加 -ism：山名变成了过程名。

normal.en: The family runs volcanism, volcanic, volcanically, volcanology, volcanologist and cryovolcanism.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 volcanism、volcanic、volcanically、volcanology、volcanologist、cryovolcanism。

normal.en: Style pairs fix the meaning: effusive volcanism, explosive volcanism.
normal.cn: 方式搭配固定词义：溢流式火山作用、爆炸式火山作用。

normal.en: Planetary contexts extend it: global volcanism, planetary volcanism, subglacial volcanism.
normal.cn: 行星语境扩展它的用法：全球火山作用、行星火山作用、冰下火山作用。

normal.en: Spelling note: modern science writes volcanism, while vulcanism survives as an older and alchemy-tinged variant.
normal.cn: 拼写提示：现代科学写作 volcanism，而 vulcanism 作为较旧且带炼金术色彩的异体仍存。

abstract.en: Picture a kettle that never stops steaming, even when nobody is watching.
abstract.cn: 想象一只没人看守却始终冒汽的水壶。

abstract.en: Picture a slow conveyor laying new floor tiles from below, year after year.
abstract.cn: 想象一条缓慢的传送带，年复一年从下面铺出新地砖。

abstract.en: Picture a city whose subway map shows many lines rising from one deep source.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地铁图，许多线路从同一个深处源头升起。

examples.en: Volcanism built the island chain over millions of years.
examples.cn: 火山作用在数百万年间建起了这条岛链。

examples.en: Satellite images revealed active volcanism beneath the ice sheet.
examples.cn: 卫星图像显示冰盖之下存在活跃的火山作用。

examples.en: The course compares Earth's volcanism with the ice-driven kind on distant moons.
examples.cn: 这门课程把地球的火山作用与遥远卫星上由冰驱动的类型作比较。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「volcan（火山）＋ism（过程、体系）」——把山名变成持续发生的过程 → 火山作用

root: volcano（← 意大利语 vulcano ← 拉丁 Volcanus「火神」）+ 后缀 -ism（← 希腊 -ismos，经拉丁 -ismus）→ volcanism；词指过程，不指山体。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow a process rather than an object: the process itself, its global pattern, its planetary reach, its eruption styles, its record in old rock, its icy variant, its effect on climate, and its status as a measured science.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着一个过程而非一个物件展开：过程本身、全球格局、行星范围、喷发方式、古老岩石中的记录、冰质变体、对气候的影响，最后成为被测量的学科对象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: melt rising through a crack, piling a cone and feeding the air above.
core.cn: 核心意象：熔融物沿裂缝上涌，堆起锥丘，并向上方大气供料。

branches.en: THE PROCESS: activity, not a thing, which is what -ism contributes.
branches.cn: 过程本身：是活动而非物件，这正是 -ism 带来的意义。

branches.en: WHERE IT HAPPENS: a pattern on a world map, then a process on any solid body.
branches.cn: 发生之处：先是世界地图上的格局，随后是任何固态天体上的过程。

branches.en: HOW IT HAPPENS: quiet flows and violent columns are two modes of one process.
branches.cn: 发生方式：安静的岩流与猛烈的灰柱是同一过程的两种模式。

branches.en: DEEP TIME AND COLD FLUIDS: the same frame survives in old rock and in icy eruptions.
branches.cn: 深时与冷流体：同一框架在古老岩石与冰质喷发中都成立。

branches.en: EFFECT AND STUDY: outputs change the climate, and the process becomes a measured object.
branches.cn: 影响与研究：产物改变气候，过程本身成为被测量的对象。

intro.en: Volcanism joins a borrowed proper-name stem to a productive suffix, which is why the word names a process despite its foreign root.
intro.cn: volcanism 把一个借入的专名词干接到一个能产后缀上，因此尽管词根来自外语，这个词却指一种过程。

latinIntro.en: Latin Volcanus supplies the stem, and Latin -ismus, from Greek -ismos, supplies the process suffix seen in volcanism.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 Volcanus 提供词干，来自希腊 -ismos 的拉丁 -ismus 提供 volcanism 中所见的过程后缀。

senses.title: Romantic person
senses.definition: a person who shows love in a tender way or holds idealistic views

senses.example: She is a romantic who keeps every letter.
senses.exampleCN: 她是个浪漫的人，保存着每一封信。

intro.en: Romantic comes from Latin romanicus, of Rome, by way of French romanz.
intro.cn: romantic 经法语 romanz 源自拉丁语 romanicus，意为罗马的。

items.en: Romanicus means of Rome or Roman.
items.cn: romanicus 意为罗马的或罗马人的。

items.en: Old French romanz names a story in the common tongue.
items.cn: 古法语 romanz 指用通俗语言写的故事。

items.en: English romance first means a tale of knights.
items.cn: 英语 romance 最初指骑士故事。

items.en: Romantic adds the feeling of love and wonder.
items.cn: romantic 增加了爱情与惊奇的情感。

items.en: Romantic also means unrealistic or idealistic.
items.cn: romantic 又表示不切实际或理想化。

note.en: Romantic is tender and ideal; Roman is about ancient Rome.
note.cn: romantic 是温柔而理想的，Roman 则与古罗马有关。

definition_zh: n. 一炉；一批（一次做出或处理的量）；一组（同时处理的人或物）　v. 分批处理
definition_en: a quantity of something produced or dealt with at one time; a group handled together; to divide work into batches
core_image: 凌晨三点整盘推进炉膛的那一炉面包
scene: 面包房凌晨三点开了第一炉，热气把玻璃糊白了。 The bakery opened its first batch at three in the morning, and the steam clouded the glass.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：batch 指一次烘烤做出的整批量；句意是面包房凌晨三点开出第一炉。

derivatives.zh: 一批；一组（拍卖或交易用语）

senses.title: One oven load
senses.definition: the whole quantity of bread or other goods produced in a single operation
senses.definitionCN: 一次操作中做出的全部面包或其他产品
senses.example: The second batch came out darker than the first.
senses.exampleCN: 第二炉比第一炉颜色更深。
senses.why: The word is a noun built on bake, so its first meaning is exactly what one heating produces.
senses.whyCN: 该词是建在 bake「烘烤」上的名词，因此初义正是「一次加热所出」。

senses.title: A group handled together
senses.definition: a set of people or things dealt with at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 同时处理的一组人或一批物
senses.example: A new batch of applicants arrived on Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 周一又来了一批申请人。
senses.why: The oven is dropped and only the togetherness remains, which lets the word cover people and data.
senses.whyCN: 烤炉被抽掉，只剩「一起」这一层，于是该词也能指人和数据。

senses.title: To group into batches
senses.definition: to arrange work or data so that it is processed in groups rather than one by one
senses.definitionCN: 把作业或数据安排成组处理，而非逐件处理
senses.example: The system batches the invoices overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 系统在夜间把发票分批处理。
senses.why: Computing turned the noun back into a verb, because queued group processing is exactly the oven pattern.
senses.whyCN: 计算机把这个名词又转回动词，因为排队成组处理正是烤炉那一套模式。

intro.en: Batch is a noun grown out of bake: one heating of the oven, then any set made or handled together, then a computing term.
intro.cn: batch 是从 bake「烘烤」长出的名词：先是炉中一次加热，再是任何一起制作或处理的集合，最后成为计算机术语。

items.en: The root bhe meant to warm or heat, the deep source of bake.
items.cn: 词根 bhe 意为使暖、加热，是 bake 的深层来源。

items.en: Old English bacan meant to bake, and its noun side gave a word for a baking.
items.cn: 古英语 bacan 意为烘烤，其名词一侧给出「一次烘烤」之词。

items.en: Middle English bache names the whole quantity of bread baked in one heating.
items.cn: 中古英语 bache 指一次加热中烤出的全部面包。

items.en: The spelling settles as batch, still tied to the oven.
items.cn: 拼写定为 batch，仍与烤炉相连。

items.en: The word widens from bread to any set of things made or handled together.
items.cn: 词义由面包扩为任何一起制作或处理的集合。

items.en: Batch processing names work queued and run without a person at each step.
items.cn: 批处理指排队执行、无需逐步人工干预的作业。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the -atch shape so the spelling sticks; the near-meaning group covers trade, shipping and statistics words for a group.
note.cn: 形近组保留 -atch 字形以固化拼写；近义组覆盖贸易、航运与统计中表示「一组」的词。

normalIntro.en: Batch is bake with a different tail: what comes out of the oven in one go is a batch.
normalIntro.cn: batch 就是 bake 换了个尾巴：一次从炉里出来的东西就是一 batch。

normal.en: Bake is the action; batch is the result.
normal.cn: bake 是动作，batch 是结果。

normal.en: One tray in, one tray out: that is a batch.
normal.cn: 一盘进、一盘出，那就是一 batch。

normal.en: Batches is the plural, with -es after ch.
normal.cn: 复数是 batches，ch 后加 -es。

normal.en: In batches means not all at once.
normal.cn: in batches 意为不一次全做。

normal.en: Batch processing runs a queue while you sleep.

abstract.en: A group defined only by when it was made.

abstract.en: Patience built into a machine.

dict_mnemonic.text: 换尾记忆：bake「烤」把 ke 换成 tch 就是 batch「一炉、一批」。一条线记住：一炉面包 → 一批货 → 一批人 → 分批处理。复数 batches。

root: 与 bake 同族，上溯原始印欧语词根 bhe「加热」；古英语 bacan「烘烤」的名词一侧产生 bæcce，中古英语约 1400 年作 bache「一次烤出的量」，16 世纪定为 batch。18 世纪扩指任何一起处理的集合，1950 年代进入计算机成为 batch processing。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses, one container of time: what one oven produces, what one moment gathers, and what a machine queues.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项，一个装时间的容器：一炉所出、一刻所聚、一机所排。

definition_en: to produce young, or to make a copy of something so that it can be seen or heard again
core_image: 一台复印机把同一页纸一张张吐出来，图案几乎一模一样
scene: 春天的池塘里，青蛙产下卵，几周后小蝌蚪成群游动。 Frogs reproduce in shallow water every spring.
sceneCN: 这里 reproduce 是「繁殖」（第 1 个义项：生物产生后代）；句意：青蛙每年春天在浅水里繁殖。

senses.title: To produce young
senses.definition: for a living thing to produce young or new individuals
senses.definitionCN: 生物产生幼体或新的个体
senses.example: These birds reproduce once a year.
senses.exampleCN: 这些鸟每年繁殖一次。
senses.why: The word is re- plus produce, and life producing new life is the most literal kind of producing again.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 re- 加 produce，生命产生新的生命，正是最字面的「再次生产」。

senses.title: To make a copy
senses.definition: to make a copy of a document, picture, or object
senses.definitionCN: 制作文件、图片或物品的副本
senses.example: The machine can reproduce the page in colour.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器可以彩色复制这一页。
senses.why: Copying produces the same thing again, matching the re- pattern without any living sense.
senses.whyCN: 复制是把同样的东西再做出来，符合 re- 的模式，但与生物无关。

senses.title: To recreate sound or image
senses.definition: to play or show a recording so that a sound or picture appears again
senses.definitionCN: 播放录音或影像，使声音或画面再次出现
senses.example: The old tape still reproduces her voice clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 这盘旧磁带仍能清楚地重现她的声音。
senses.why: A recording keeps a sound and produces it again later, which is another form of producing again.
senses.whyCN: 录音把声音保存下来，日后再次放出，是「再次生产」的另一种形式。

senses.title: To produce results again
senses.definition: to obtain the same result again in an experiment or process
senses.definitionCN: 在实验或过程中再次得到同样的结果
senses.example: Other labs could not reproduce the findings.
senses.exampleCN: 其他实验室无法重现这些发现。
senses.why: Science uses the word for making a result appear again, extending it from objects to outcomes.
senses.whyCN: 科学用它表示让结果再次出现，把词义从物件扩展到结果。

intro.en: Reproduce is an English formation from re-, again, and produce, from Latin producere, to lead forth.
intro.cn: reproduce 是英语用 re-（再次）与 produce（源自拉丁语 producere「引出」）构成的词。

items.en: Producere means to lead or bring forth, from pro-, forward, and ducere, to lead.
items.cn: producere 意为引出、带出，由 pro-（向前）与 ducere（引导）构成。

items.en: The noun productum names something brought forth or produced.
items.cn: 名词 productum 指被引出或生产出来的东西。

items.en: English produce appears with the sense of bringing something into being.
items.cn: 英语 produce 出现，表示使某物产生。

items.en: Reproduce is formed to mean produce again, especially living offspring.
items.cn: reproduce 被构成，表示再次生产，尤指产生后代。

items.en: Printing and photography give the word the sense of making copies.
items.cn: 印刷与摄影赋予这个词「复制」的含义。

items.en: Modern English adds recorded sound and repeated experimental results.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了录音再现和实验结果复现的用法。

note.en: Reproduce joins the produce family to the prefix re-, and it sits beside words for breeding and copying.
note.cn: reproduce 把 produce 词族与前缀 re- 结合，与表示繁殖和复制的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of reproducing, or a copy
entries.definitionCN: 繁殖；复制品

entries.definition: relating to producing young
entries.definitionCN: 生殖的

entries.definition: able to be copied or repeated
entries.definitionCN: 可复制的；可重复的

entries.definition: to produce young animals
entries.definitionCN: 繁殖；饲养

entries.definition: to make something look the same as another
entries.definitionCN: 复制；抄写

entries.definition: to copy something exactly, especially in an experiment
entries.definitionCN: 精确复制；重复实验

entries.definition: to make an exact second copy
entries.definitionCN: 复制；加倍

normalIntro.en: Reproduce is re- plus produce, so the whole word means produce again, whether that is offspring, a copy, a sound, or a result.
normalIntro.cn: reproduce 就是 re- 加 produce，整个词意为「再次生产」，无论是后代、副本、声音还是结果。

normal.en: Re- means again, and produce means bring forth: bring forth again.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，produce 表示生产：再次生产出来。

normal.en: Animals reproduce by producing young.
normal.cn: 动物通过产生幼体来繁殖。

normal.en: A photocopier reproduces a page.
normal.cn: 复印机复制一页纸。

normal.en: A speaker reproduces recorded sound.
normal.cn: 扬声器再现录制的声音。

normal.en: A good experiment can be reproduced by another lab.
normal.cn: 好的实验能被另一个实验室复现。

abstract.en: Picture one page sliding out of a copier as an identical page.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸从复印机里滑出，变成一模一样的一页。

abstract.en: Imagine a pond filling with tadpoles in spring.
abstract.cn: 想象春天的池塘里挤满蝌蚪。

abstract.en: Think of a voice held in a tape and released years later.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音被封存在磁带里，多年后再次放出。

examples.en: Bacteria reproduce very quickly in warm conditions.
examples.cn: 细菌在温暖环境中繁殖得很快。

examples.en: The gallery reproduced the famous painting for the exhibition.
examples.cn: 美术馆为展览复制了那幅名画。

examples.en: No other team could reproduce the result.
examples.cn: 没有其他团队能重现这个结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ produce（生产）＝再生产，即繁殖或复制；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: re-（再次）+ produce（生产，源自拉丁语 producere「引出」）→ 17 世纪英语构成，本义「再生产」，后扩展为繁殖、复制、再现。

sensesIntro.en: Producing again starts with living offspring, then copies of objects, then recorded sound, and finally the reappearance of a scientific result.
sensesIntro.cn: 「再次生产」从生命后代开始，再到物件副本，再到录制的声音，最后是科学结果的再次出现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same thing produced once more, from a new animal to a new copy.
core.cn: 核心意象：同样的东西再被生产一次，从新的生命到新的副本。

branches.en: Living things producing young is the biological sense.
branches.cn: 生物产生后代，是生物学义项。

branches.en: Making a copy is the same repetition applied to objects.
branches.cn: 制作副本，是同样的重复作用在物件上。

branches.en: Replaying sound or image makes a past moment appear again.
branches.cn: 重放声音或影像，让过去的瞬间再次出现。

branches.en: Repeating an experimental result is reproduction in science.
branches.cn: 重复实验结果，是科学中的「复现」。

branches.en: Offspring and copies both carry the same pattern into a new instance.
branches.cn: 后代与副本都把同样的模式带入新的个体。

intro.en: Reproduce combines the Latin prefix re- with produce, itself built from Latin pro- and ducere.
intro.cn: reproduce 把拉丁前缀 re- 与 produce 结合，而 produce 本身由拉丁语 pro- 与 ducere 构成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, pro- means forward, and ducere means to lead, so producere is to lead forth.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，pro- 表示向前，ducere 表示引导，所以 producere 就是「引出」。

items.example: Re- opens reproduce.
items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 reproduce 开头。

items.example: Pro- appears in produce and proceed.
items.exampleCN: pro- 出现在 produce 与 proceed 中。

items.example: Ducere is the root of produce.
items.exampleCN: ducere 是 produce 的词根。

items.example: Producere joins pro- and ducere.
items.exampleCN: producere 由 pro- 与 ducere 合成。

items.example: Produce is the base of reproduce.
items.exampleCN: produce 是 reproduce 的基础词。

items.example: Reproduce adds re- to produce.
items.exampleCN: reproduce 在 produce 前加 re-。

items.example: Reproduction adds -tion to reproduce.
items.exampleCN: reproduction 在 reproduce 后加 -tion。

items.example: Reproductive adds -ive to reproduce.
items.exampleCN: reproductive 在 reproduce 后加 -ive。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -tion forms reproduction.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tion 构成 reproduction。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms reproductive.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ive 构成 reproductive。

definition_zh: 商人；（批发的）货商；酒商、煤炭商等专营商人；商船的
definition_en: a person or firm that buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities or across borders
core_image: 码头仓库门口，一个穿长外套的人对着账本清点整匹的布，身后是刚卸下的货堆
scene: 码头仓库里，收货人掀开帆布，逐匹检查刚卸下的丝绸，账本上记着欠款与运费。 The merchant sold silk by the bale and never dealt in single bolts.
sceneCN: 这里 merchant 指「以大宗货物跨地买卖为业的人」（第 1 个义项：作为从事大宗贸易的商人）；句意为这位商人按整包卖丝绸，从不拆成单匹零售；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 商船的；商业的（多见于 merchant ship、merchant navy）

derivatives.zh: merchant + -ise（名词后缀）→ 商品；推销（语义偏移：从人转到货）
merchandise + -ing（动名词）→ 货品推广与陈列
merchant + -able（可…的）→ 适销的（法律用语）
merchant + man → 商船（语义偏移：从人转到船）
意大利 mercante + -ile → 贸易的；重商的
com- + merx → 商业（同根，走抽象活动那条线）

senses.title: Trader in goods, especially wholesale
senses.titleCN: 从事货物买卖的商人（尤指批发）
senses.definition: a person or firm that buys goods in quantity and sells them on, often across distance
senses.definitionCN: 成批买进再转售的个人或企业，常跨距离经营
senses.example: The merchant sold silk by the bale and never dealt in single bolts.
senses.exampleCN: 这位商人按整包卖丝绸，从不拆成单匹零售。
senses.why: Latin mercari 'to trade' plus the person suffix -ant gives the one who trades, and the word keeps the bulk-dealing sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 mercari「做买卖」加人称后缀 -ant 给出「做买卖的人」，而这个词保留了成批交易之义。

senses.title: A shopkeeper, in older British use
senses.definition: dated: a retail shopkeeper, especially one who owns the shop
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：零售店主，尤指店铺所有者
senses.example: The village merchant knew every family's account by heart.
senses.exampleCN: 村里的店主把每家的账都记在心里。
senses.why: Before chain stores, the local shopkeeper was simply the person who traded, so the word needed no qualifier.
senses.whyCN: 在连锁店出现之前，本地店主就是做买卖的那个人，因此这个词无需限定语。

senses.title: Dealer in one commodity
senses.titleCN: 某一类货品的专营商人
senses.definition: a specialist dealer whose trade is named with the word, as a wine merchant or coal merchant
senses.definitionCN: 以本词构成称谓的专营商人，如酒商、煤商
senses.example: The wine merchant will not open a bottle that has not rested a year.
senses.exampleCN: 那位酒商不肯开一瓶还没放满一年的酒。
senses.why: The compound pattern merchant of X narrows the general trader to one stock.
senses.whyCN: 「X + merchant」这一复合模式把一般商人收窄到一种货品。

senses.title: Wholesaler supplying retailers
senses.titleCN: 向零售商供货的批发商
senses.definition: a middle trader who buys from producers and supplies shops rather than end customers
senses.definitionCN: 从生产者买进、供给店铺而非最终顾客的中间商
senses.example: Retailers complained that the merchant kept the best lots for himself.
senses.exampleCN: 零售商抱怨那位批发商把最好的货留给了自己。
senses.why: Scale separates the merchant from the shop: one moves cases, the other sells units.
senses.whyCN: 规模把 merchant 与店铺分开：一个搬整箱，一个卖单件。

senses.title: Member of a chartered trading company
senses.definition: historical: a member of a company granted a monopoly of trade with a region
senses.definitionCN: 历史用法：获得某地区贸易垄断权的公司成员
senses.example: A merchant of the company could lose his charter for private dealing.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司的商人若私自交易，会被吊销特许状。
senses.why: Charters turned merchants into licensed agents of a state, and the word absorbed that status.
senses.whyCN: 特许状把商人变成国家的受许代理人，这个词也就吸收了那层身份。

senses.title: One who trades in something abstract
senses.titleCN: 经营抽象之物的人（比喻）
senses.definition: figuratively, a person who circulates a quality or a commodity that is not goods, as a merchant of doubt
senses.definitionCN: 比喻指流通某种非货物之物的人，如散布疑虑者
senses.example: He is a merchant of doubt, paid by the column and never by the fact.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个贩卖疑虑的人，按专栏收钱，从不按事实收钱。
senses.why: If goods can be sold, anything marketable can be sold, so the person noun travels with them.
senses.whyCN: 既然货物能卖，任何可售之物都能卖，指人的名词便随之而去。

senses.title: Attributive use for shipping
senses.definition: used before nouns to mark vessels or fleets that carry commercial cargo rather than troops
senses.definitionCN: 置于名词前，标出载运商业货物而非军队的船只或船队
senses.example: The merchant fleet was requisitioned before the war began.
senses.exampleCN: 战争开始前，商船队就被征用了。
senses.why: A trader on land becomes a ship at sea, and the noun works as a plain classifier.
senses.whyCN: 陆上的商人在海上成了船，这个名词便充当简单的分类语。

senses.title: Promoter of something unwelcome
senses.titleCN: 推销不受欢迎之物的人
senses.definition: in modern compounds, a person who promotes a bad thing as if selling it, as a doom merchant
senses.definitionCN: 在现代复合词中，指把坏东西当作货品来推销的人，如唱衰者
senses.example: The paper calls every forecaster a doom merchant.
senses.exampleCN: 这家报纸把每个预测者都叫作唱衰者。
senses.why: The selling frame is so strong that it can be attached to ideas nobody wants to buy.
senses.whyCN: 兜售这一框架太强，以至于可以挂到没人想买的主张上。

intro.en: Merchant is the person-shaped member of the goods family: the same Latin noun for merchandise, put through a verb of trading and a French suffix for people.
intro.cn: merchant 是「货物」词族中取人形的那个成员：同一个表商品的拉丁名词，经一个表交易的动词与一个法语人称后缀而成。

items.en: Merx, genitive mercis, meant 'merchandise, goods'. Its deeper origin is uncertain; the links sometimes proposed to a trading root are hypotheses, not established derivations.
items.cn: merx（属格 mercis）意为「货物、商品」。其更深来源不确定；有人提出的与某个交易词根的联系只是假说，并非已成立的派生。

items.en: Mercari 'to trade, to deal' is the deponent verb built on merx; it supplies the stem that carries the person suffix.
items.cn: mercari「做买卖、交易」是建于 merx 之上的异态动词，提供了承载人称后缀的词干。

items.en: Mercator 'trader' is the direct Latin person noun, and it survives in English in learned and historical writing.
items.cn: mercator「商人」是直接的拉丁人称名词，在英语的学术与历史写作中仍可见到。

items.en: Old French marchant names a trader or shopkeeper and is the form English borrowed, with the -ch- that English later reduced.
items.cn: 古法语 marchant 指商人或店主，是英语借入的形式，其中的 -ch- 后来在英语里弱化。

items.en: Early English spellings vary between marchaunt and merchant; the word covers both the long-distance trader and the local shopkeeper.
items.cn: 早期英语拼写在 marchaunt 与 merchant 之间摆动；这个词同时涵盖长途商人与本地店主。

items.en: Modern English separates merchant from shopkeeper and keeps the word for wholesale, specialist and shipping uses; the compound patterns wine merchant and doom merchant show both ends of that range.
items.cn: 现代英语把 merchant 与店主分开，保留批发、专营与航运用法；wine merchant 与 doom merchant 这两个复合模式正显出这一区间的两端。

note.en: The first group shares the goods root or the shape; the second holds words for the people who sell at different points in the chain.
note.cn: 第一组共享货物词根或外形；第二组是销售链条不同环节上的人。

entries.definition: The noun for goods bought and sold, formed from merchant; it names the cargo, not the trader.
entries.definitionCN: 指买卖的货物，由 merchant 构成；它指货，不指人。

entries.definition: Describing trade or a policy bent on profit; it came through Italian and has no plural or person form.
entries.definitionCN: 描述贸易或唯利是图的政策；经意大利语而来，无人称或复数形式。

entries.definition: A commercial-law word meaning fit to be sold, said of goods rather than of people.
entries.definitionCN: 商法用词，意为适销，说的是货物而非人。

entries.definition: The abstract noun of trade; merchant is the person who carries it on.
entries.definitionCN: 指贸易的抽象名词；merchant 是从事贸易的人。

entries.definition: Anyone who trades, including a market stall or a brokerage desk; merchant sounds older and grander.
entries.definitionCN: 任何做交易的人，包括市场摊位或经纪台；merchant 显得更老派、更有分量。

entries.definition: A specialist buyer and seller, as a car dealer or an art dealer; merchant often implies bulk and distance.
entries.definitionCN: 某一商品或市场的专营买卖者，如汽车经销商、艺术品经销商；merchant 常含大宗与跨地之意。

entries.definition: A trader who sells to shops rather than to households; the word names a position, not a tradition.
entries.definitionCN: 卖给店铺而非住户的商人；这个词标出链条位置，而非一种传统。

entries.definition: The person behind a shop counter; it fixes the word to one premises, which merchant never does.
entries.definitionCN: 站在店铺柜台后的人；它把人固定在某一处店面，而 merchant 从不这样限定。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: merx 'goods' + -ant 'person': the person of goods.
normal.cn: merx「货物」+ -ant「人」：货物的人。

normal.en: The family runs merchant, merchandise, merchandising, merchantable, merchantman, mercantile, commerce.
normal.cn: 同族词有 merchant、merchandise、merchandising、merchantable、merchantman、mercantile、commerce。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark specialities: wine merchant, coal merchant, merchant bank, merchant ship.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出专营：酒商、煤商、商人银行、商船。

normal.en: The word moved from person to cargo: merchant sells merchandise.
normal.cn: 这个词从人走到货：merchant 卖 merchandise。

normal.en: Merchantman is a ship, not a man, a reminder that the suffix once meant a vessel.
normal.cn: merchantman 是船而非人，提醒人们这个后缀曾指船只。

abstract.en: Picture a ledger in which every page is a debt and every debt is a bale of cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一本账册，每一页是一笔欠款，每笔欠款是一包布。

abstract.en: Picture a charter that turns a private trader into an arm of the state.
abstract.cn: 想象一份特许状，把私人商人变成国家的一只手臂。

abstract.en: Picture a newspaper column written by someone who sells fear by the word.
abstract.cn: 想象一个按字出售恐惧的人所写的报纸专栏。

examples.en: A merchant from Genoa financed the voyage and took a third of the cargo.
examples.cn: 一位热那亚商人资助了这次航行，并取走三分之一的货。

examples.en: The coal merchant delivers on Wednesdays and will not come for a single sack.
examples.cn: 煤商每周三送货，不会为一袋煤专门跑一趟。

examples.en: Merchant ships were stopped and searched for contraband.
examples.cn: 商船被拦下搜查违禁品。

dict_mnemonic.text: merce（货物）＋ ant（人）＝ 管货物的人；记「整包进、整包出，账本不离手」。

root: 拉丁 merx（属格 mercis）「货物」→ mercari「做买卖」→ 拉丁 mercator「商人」→ 古法语 marchant → 英语 merchant；merx 更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses trace one trader through the chain: bulk dealer, local shopkeeper, single-commodity specialist, wholesaler, chartered agent, dealer in abstractions, shipping classifier, and promoter of bad news.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让一个商人沿链条走一遍：大宗商、本地店主、单一货品专营者、批发商、受特许的代理人、抽象之物的经营者、航运的分类语，以及坏消息的推销者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ledger, a bale and a long walk between the quay and the shop.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本账册、一包货，以及码头与店铺之间那段长路。

branches.en: BULK AND COUNTER: the same trader scaled down to a village shop before chain stores existed.
branches.cn: 大宗与柜台：同一个商人在连锁店出现之前缩小为村里的店铺。

branches.en: SPECIALITY AND POSITION: one stock only, and a place in the chain between maker and shop.
branches.cn: 专营与位置：只做一种货，并在制作者与店铺之间占一个环节。

branches.en: LICENSED TRADER: a charter converts private dealing into a granted monopoly.

branches.en: ANYTHING SELLABLE: doubt and doom can be stocked and sold like cloth.
branches.cn: 任何可售之物：疑虑与唱衰也能像布匹一样囤积出售。

branches.cn: 外在形态：在海上商人成船，在纸面上成为坏消息的售卖者。

intro.en: Merchant is a Latin goods noun plus a Latin person suffix, filtered through French; the same root builds the words for goods, for trade policy and for the market itself.
intro.cn: merchant 是一个拉丁货物名词加一个拉丁人称后缀，经法语过滤而成；同一词根还构成指商品、指贸易政策与指市场本身的词。

latinIntro.en: From merx come mercari 'to trade', mercator 'trader', mercatus 'market' and commercium 'trade together'; English draws merchant, merchandise and commerce from that single stock.
latinIntro.cn: 由 merx 生出 mercari「交易」、mercator「商人」、mercatus「市场」与 commercium「共同交易」；英语从这一处取来 merchant、merchandise 与 commerce。

items.exampleCN: 这个后缀为货物造出一条法律标准。

definition_zh: 数据分析
definition_en: the process of inspecting, cleaning, transforming and modelling data in order to extract useful information and support conclusions
core_image: 桌上一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行
scene: 桌上摊着一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行。 Data analysis turns a messy table into a claim that can be checked.
sceneCN: 这里指对数据进行检查、清洗与建模的整个过程（第 1 个义项：系统的数据考察）；句意为数据分析把一张杂乱的表格变成可核查的主张。图中可辨识物件：原始表格、屏幕图表、废纸篓、键盘、批注笔。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 datum 的复数而来，义为「数据」
由拉丁语 dare「给出」的过去分词而来，义为「给定的事实；数据点」
由希腊语 analusis「拆解」而来，义为「分析」
由其动词形式而来，义为「分析」
由该动词加表示施动者的词尾构成，义为「分析者」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「分析的」

senses.title: The general process of examining data
senses.definition: the whole sequence of inspecting, cleaning, transforming and interpreting data to answer a question
senses.definitionCN: 为回答问题而检查、清洗、转换与解释数据的完整流程
senses.example: Data analysis turns a messy table into a claim that can be checked.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析把一张杂乱的表格变成可核查的主张。
senses.why: Raw records do not answer questions by themselves; they must be ordered before they can speak.
senses.whyCN: 原始记录本身不回答问题，必须先被整理才能说话。

senses.title: Statistical analysis
senses.definition: the use of summary measures, models and tests to describe data and judge hypotheses
senses.definitionCN: 用汇总指标、模型与检验来描述数据并判断假设
senses.example: The statistical part of data analysis estimated the effect and its interval.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析中的统计部分估计了效应及其区间。
senses.why: When the question is about size and uncertainty, the analysis needs a probability model.
senses.whyCN: 当问题涉及大小与不确定性时，分析就需要一个概率模型。

senses.title: Analysis of qualitative material
senses.definition: the systematic reading and coding of interviews, documents or observations to identify themes and meanings
senses.definitionCN: 对访谈、文件或观察进行系统阅读与编码，以识别主题与意义
senses.example: Data analysis of the transcripts produced four themes and a revised coding frame.
senses.exampleCN: 对逐字稿的数据分析产生了四个主题与一版修订编码框架。
senses.why: Not all evidence arrives as numbers, and text needs its own disciplined route from raw record to finding.
senses.whyCN: 并非所有证据都以数字到来，文本需要自己那条从原始记录到发现的严谨路径。

senses.title: Cleaning and preparation
senses.definition: the work of detecting missing values, errors, duplicates and inconsistencies before modelling begins
senses.definitionCN: 在建模开始前发现缺失值、错误、重复与不一致的工作
senses.example: Most of the data analysis time went into cleaning the merged files.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分数据分析时间花在清洗合并后的文件上。
senses.why: Every model assumes the table is already coherent, and someone must make that assumption true.
senses.whyCN: 每个模型都假定表格已经自洽，而必须有人把这个假定变成事实。

senses.title: Exploratory analysis
senses.definition: an open-ended examination of patterns, distributions and anomalies before a formal hypothesis is fixed
senses.definitionCN: 在正式假设确定之前，对模式、分布与异常进行的开放式考察
senses.example: Exploratory data analysis revealed a cluster that the original design had not expected.
senses.exampleCN: 探索性数据分析揭示出原始设计没有预料到的一个群体。
senses.why: The analyst first looks around the data without a verdict in mind, so that surprise can still occur.
senses.whyCN: 分析者先不带结论地环视数据，这样惊讶才有可能发生。

senses.title: Confirmatory analysis
senses.definition: a planned test of a stated hypothesis using rules fixed before the data are examined
senses.definitionCN: 用查看数据之前固定的规则，对已陈述假设进行计划性检验
senses.example: Confirmatory data analysis requires the model to be specified in advance.
senses.exampleCN: 验证性数据分析要求模型预先写明。
senses.why: Once a hypothesis is fixed, the analysis becomes a fair test rather than a search for a story.
senses.whyCN: 假设一旦固定，分析就成为公平检验，而不是寻找故事。

senses.title: Computational analysis
senses.definition: the use of algorithms, databases and software to process data at a scale beyond hand calculation
senses.definitionCN: 用算法、数据库与软件处理超出人工计算规模的数据
senses.example: The data analysis pipeline ran overnight on the cluster.
senses.exampleCN: 这条数据分析流水线在集群上跑了一整夜。
senses.why: Scale changes the method: what is possible with a thousand rows is not the same as what is possible with a billion.
senses.whyCN: 规模改变方法：一千行的可能与十亿行的可能不是一回事。

senses.title: Interpretation and reporting
senses.definition: the step that turns results into statements about the world, with limits, assumptions and uncertainty made explicit
senses.definitionCN: 把结果转化为关于世界的陈述，并明确限度、假设与不确定性
senses.example: The final stage of data analysis is writing what the numbers do and do not support.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析的最后一步，是写清这些数字支持什么、不支持什么。
senses.why: A table of results is not yet a finding; someone must state what it means and where it stops.
senses.whyCN: 一张结果表还不是发现，必须有人说明它意味着什么、到哪里为止。

intro.en: Data analysis joins data, the plural of Latin datum, something given, to analysis, from Greek analusis, a loosening or dissolving.
intro.cn: 这个术语把 data（拉丁语 datum「被给予之物」的复数）与 analysis（希腊语 analusis「拆解」）组合起来。

items.en: Dare meant to give, and the participle datum named a thing given or granted.
items.cn: dare 意为给予，分词 datum 指被给予或授予之物。

items.en: Datum named a given fact, and its plural data became the English mass noun for records.
items.cn: datum 指给定的事实，其复数 data 成为英语中指记录的物质名词。

items.en: English used data for facts and later for digital records; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 data 指事实，后来指数字记录；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Analusis meant a loosening or resolving of a compound into its parts.
items.cn: analusis 意为把复合体拆解为各部分的松开过程。

items.en: Ana- meant up or throughout, and luein meant to loosen; together they describe taking something apart.
items.cn: ana- 意为向上或贯穿，luein 意为松开；合起来指把某物拆开。

items.en: Statistics and computing joined the two words for the whole workflow from records to conclusions; the phrase is twentieth-century.
items.cn: 统计学与计算把这两个词组合成从记录到结论的完整流程；这个短语属二十世纪。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like data analysis; the second group names neighbouring stages of working with evidence.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 data analysis 相近；第二组是与「处理证据」意思相邻的阶段。

entries.definition: Records, measurements or facts in any form.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何形式的记录、测量或事实。

entries.definition: A single given fact or measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 指单个给定的事实或测量值。

entries.definition: The breaking of a whole into its parts for examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指把整体拆成部分加以考察。

entries.definition: To carry out such an examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指进行这样的考察。

entries.definition: A person who performs analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 指从事分析的人。

entries.definition: The science and practice of summarising and testing data.
entries.definitionCN: 指对数据进行汇总与检验的学问与实践。

entries.definition: Detecting and correcting errors before analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 指在分析前发现并纠正错误。

entries.definition: Searching large datasets for unsuspected patterns.
entries.definitionCN: 指在大数据集中搜寻未预料到的模式。

entries.definition: Assigning meaning to results.
entries.definitionCN: 指为结果赋予意义。

entries.definition: Labelling qualitative material into categories.
entries.definitionCN: 指把定性材料标注为各类别。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: Data is the plural of a word for something given, and analysis is a loosening, so the phrase means loosening what was given.
normal.cn: 「数据」是「被给予之物」的复数，「分析」是「松开」，这个短语指把被给予的东西拆开。

normal.en: Cleaning comes before modelling, because a model cannot repair an inconsistent table.
normal.cn: 清洗在建模之前，因为模型无法修复一张自相矛盾的表格。

normal.en: Exploratory analysis looks around, while confirmatory analysis tests a promise made earlier.
normal.cn: 探索性分析四处环视，验证性分析检验早先作出的承诺。

normal.en: The last step is not a number but a sentence with limits attached.
normal.cn: 最后一步不是一个数字，而是一句带着限度的话。

normal.en: Computing changed the scale of data analysis without changing its need for a question.
normal.cn: 计算改变了数据分析的规模，却没有改变它对问题的需要。

abstract.en: Data do not speak; analysis is the grammar that makes them audible.
abstract.cn: 数据不会说话，分析是使它们可被听见的语法。

abstract.en: A clean table is already an argument about what counts as an error.
abstract.cn: 一张干净的表格本身已经是关于「什么算错误」的论证。

abstract.en: The model at the end inherits every decision made at the beginning.
abstract.cn: 最后的模型继承了开始时的每一个决定。

examples.en: The paper describes the data analysis in enough detail for replication.
examples.cn: 论文对数据分析的描述详细到可以复做。

examples.en: Data analysis was separated from data collection to reduce the risk of bias.
examples.cn: 数据分析与数据收集分开，以降低偏差风险。

examples.en: The data analysis showed a pattern that the original hypothesis had not predicted.
examples.cn: 数据分析显示出一个原假设没有预测到的模式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「数据」加「分析」——先把杂乱表格洗干净，再拆开看结构，最后写成一句可核查的话：数据分析。

root: 拉丁 dare「给予」→ 过去分词 datum「被给予之物」→ 复数 data；希腊 analusis「拆解」← ana-「贯穿」+ luein「松开」→ 英语 analysis；统计学与计算把两者组合为 data analysis。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move through the workflow: the general process, statistical analysis, qualitative analysis, cleaning, exploration, confirmation, computation, and interpretation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着流程展开：总体过程、统计分析、定性分析、清洗、探索、验证、计算，以及解释。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of raw tables on a desk, a screen with a cleaned chart beside them, and deleted error rows in the wastebasket.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行。

branches.en: THE WORKFLOW AND THE CLEANING: the whole sequence, and the unglamorous work that makes it possible.
branches.cn: 流程与清洗：完整顺序，以及使顺序成为可能的琐碎工作。

branches.en: THE TWO KINDS OF EVIDENCE: numbers handled statistically, and texts handled qualitatively.
branches.cn: 两类证据：用统计处理的数字，用定性处理的文本。

branches.en: THE TWO MODES OF INQUIRY: looking around before a hypothesis, and testing one fixed in advance.
branches.cn: 两种探究方式：假设前的环视，与预先固定假设后的检验。

branches.en: THE SCALE: algorithms and software processing more than hands can hold.
branches.cn: 规模：算法与软件处理超出人手所能掌握的数据。

branches.en: THE SENTENCE AT THE END: results converted into a claim with limits.
branches.cn: 结尾的句子：结果被转换成带限度的话。

intro.en: The phrase joins the plural of a Latin participle meaning given to a Greek noun meaning a loosening.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁语「被给予」的分词复数与希腊语「拆解」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin dare and datum supply data; Greek ana- and luein supply analysis; English plurals and compound syntax do the joining.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dare 与 datum 提供「数据」，希腊语 ana- 与 luein 提供「分析」，英语复数形式与复合句法完成连接。

items.example: It supplies the participle behind data.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 data 背后的分词。

items.example: The singular still names one measurement.
items.exampleCN: 单数仍指一个测量值。

items.example: English treats it as a mass noun.
items.exampleCN: 英语把它当作物质名词。

items.example: It marks taking a whole apart.
items.exampleCN: 它标出把整体拆开。

items.example: It supplies the dissolving image in analysis.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 analysis 中「拆解」的意象。

items.structure: Greek noun from ana- plus luein
items.example: It becomes English analysis.
items.exampleCN: 它成为英语 analysis。

items.meaning: the separation of a whole into parts
items.example: The second half names the operation.
items.exampleCN: 后半命名这一操作。

items.example: It forms analyse; American spelling uses -ize.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 analyse；美式拼写作 -ize。

items.example: It forms analyst.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 analyst。

items.meaning: the workflow from records to claims
items.example: The compound is modern and covers many methods.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是现代用语，涵盖多种方法。

definition_zh: 温盐的；由温度与盐度共同决定的
definition_en: relating to the combined effect of temperature and salinity, especially on the density of seawater
core_image: 两支探头伸进同一桶海水：一支量冷热，一支量咸淡，两个读数合起来决定这水有多重
scene: 海洋学讲座上，讲者把探头放进桶里刚打上来的水样说， The thermohaline contrast between the two layers keeps them apart.
sceneCN: 这里 thermohaline 指「温度与盐度合在一起造成的（差异）」（第 1 个义项：温盐的）；句意为：两层水之间的温盐差异使它们保持分离。

pos.zh: 温盐的；由温度与盐度共同决定的
用于复合术语，如温盐环流、温盐层化

forms.label: 比较级（关系形容词，罕用）
最高级（关系形容词，罕用）
